tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer las zab don dbu ma'i spyi don lung rigs mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /swasti/bstan pa'i snying
༄༅/ /legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer las zab don dbu ma'i spyi don lung rigs mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /swasti/bstan pa'i snying

tei:bibl.tei:idno: GuruLamaWorks/Precious-and-Rare-Disk-01-20130424/rtfs/19_KHEZ/KHEZ017_zab don dbu ma'i spyi don lung rigs mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan .rtf

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer las zab don dbu ma'i spyi don lung rigs mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// swasti/ bstan pa'i snying po zab don dbu ma chen po'i lam phyin ci ma log par ston pa la dbang 'byor ba/ drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi bang mdzod rnams/ /nges don yid bzhin nor bus legs gang bas/ /skal bzang re 'dod ma lus stsol mkhas pa/ /thub dbang lha yi lha der mgos phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /byang sems mchog gyur blo gros rin chen dang / /khyad par shing rta'i srol 'byed klu sgrub zhabs/ /snying nas 'dud do brtse bas rjes su skyongs/ /nye gnas dngos grub brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor gsum/ arya de wa/ klu sgrub/ zhi ba lha/ /bstan pa gzhung lugs spel ba'i mkhas pa slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs dang / legs ldan byed gnyis/ /'chad rtsod rtsom mkhas slob dpon rnam slob dpon dpa' bo/ dpal ldan zla grags/ tsanḍa go mi/ paṇḍir 'bar ba'i gtso bo ste/ bzhi slob dpon nyi ma snan pa sogs/ /klu sgrub slob ma tshogs la gus pas 'dud/ /khyad par klu sgrub bzhed gzhung kunda'i tshal/ /ji bzhin 'byed mkhas dpal ldan zla ba dang / /rigs pa'i khu byug che chung gnyis dpal ldan mar me mdzad/ /'grel bshad dzā ya ā nan ta mkhan po rnams la'ang gus pas 'dud/ /lam bzang gsal mdzad pa tshab lo tsā ba nyi ma grags gangs pa she'u/ gtsang pa sgre sgur/ rma bya byang ye/ zhang thang sag pa ye shes 'byung gnas/ bu bzhir bcas/ /khyad par thang sag pa dang byang ye'i sras/ /rma bya byang brtson rkyang dur 'tshur ston gzhon seng dang / /sa skya'i 'jam mgon rnams la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /'u yug pa mdo sde dpal dang nor bzang brtson 'grus dpal/

/red mda' pa gzhon nu blo gros g.yag rong rnam pa gnyis/ /bstan pa'i gsal byed rab 'byams chos rje kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel rje sogs/ /brgyud ldan bla ma'i tshogs rnams deng 'dir rgyal/ /rgya chen gsung rab don la dbang 'byor zhing / /rlabs chen mdzad pas 'gro kun thar par 'dren/ /phul phyin lung rigs chos char 'bebs mkhas pa/ /bstan pa'i srol 'byed 'bum phrag gsum pa rgyal/ /de sras 'phags mchog rje dang ar ston zhabs/ /kun mkhyen ches rje paṇa grub bzang po'i mtshan/ /smra ba'i khyu mchog blo gros rnam par rgyal/ /buddha dhā dza rnams la snying nas bsngags/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gcig bsdus nas/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i dpal du lham me ba/ /bka' drin 'khor med drin can klu sgrub rjer/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal nas/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyi/ /dgongs don thal rang rig pa'i gnad zab mo/ /blo gsal mkhas pa'i tshogs la spel ba'i phyir/ /legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer bshad par bya/ /ces mchod brjod dang dam bca' sngon du btang nas 'dir dbu ma'i gzhung lugs kyi snying po mtha' bcad dang rigs lam du bkral nas/ gzhung so so'i sa bcad dang 'bru snon sogs btang snyoms su bzhag ste/ blo gsal rnams kyis 'phral go sla ba/ phugs don phigs pa/ rig pa'i bde cha la phan pa zhig 'chad par byed pas blo gsal dad ldan rnams gus pas nyan par byos shig de yang dbu ma la 'jug pa rtsa 'grel gnyis char gyi gzhung khag che ba rnams la/ dpal 'bum phrag gsum pa'i man ngag ltar ngag sbyor mtha' dpyad gnyis gnyis kyi sgo nas bshad par bya'o/ /dbu ma'i bstan bcos la 'jug par bya ba'i phyir dbu ma la 'jug pa rtsom par 'dod pas/ zhes pa'i skabs su/ ngag don gyi sbyor ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bstan bcos dbu ma la 'jug pa chos can/ khyod kyi dbu ma'i bstan bcos rtsa ba shes rab kyi dgongs pa 'grel tshul yod de/

khyod kyi rtsa she'i dgongs pa zab pa dang / rgya che ba gnyis kyi sgo nas 'grel ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ khas len pa po dbu ma pa'i rnam gzhag bshad pa/ khas blang bya dbu ma'i rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 'dir bstan 'jug bya'i dbu ma ngos bzung ba dang gsum/ dang po dbu ma pa la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba/ dngos brtags la dpyad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' smra ba bzhi po gang rung gang zhig chos thams cad bden med spros bral du khas len pa'i rigs su gnas pa de/ de'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa ni/ dbu ma pa/ ngo bo nyid med par smra ba'i dbu ma pa/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' smra ba bzhi'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa'i gang zag sher phyin gyi mdo nges don gyi mdor 'dod pa'i skyes bu/ chos thams cad bden stong spros bral du gtan la 'bebs pa'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa ste lnga don gcig gsum pa dbye ba ni/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba/ grub mtha' 'dzin tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ kun rdzob khas len gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ don dam khas len gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ sgra'i brjod rigs kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang lnga/ dang po la gzhung phyi mo'i dbu ma pa dang / grub mtha' phyogs 'dzin gyi dbu ma pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang / mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ dbu ma pa gang zhig gtso bor dbu ma thal rang gnyis su ma gyes gong gi dbu ma'i grub mtha' smra ba'i rigs su gnas pa de/ de'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa ni/ ston pa thub dbang / sher phyin gyi mdo 'chad pa'i 'khor du lhags pa'i byams pa dang / 'jam dbyangs sogs/ nye ba'i sras brgyad rnams dang sangs rgyas gnyis pa 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob dpon arya dāe wa/ rgyal sras zhi ba lha/ slob dpon dpa' bo sogs la 'jog de rnams la gzhung phyi mo'i dbu ma pa zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ grub mtha' phyogs 'dzin gyi dbu ma pa rnams 'gyes pa'i gzhi yin pas na de ltar du mtshan btags pa'o/

/gnyis pa grub mtha' phyogs 'dzin gyi dbu ma pa la/ mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ dbu ma pa gang zhig gtso bor dbu ma thal rang gnyis gyes phyin chad kyi dbu ma'i grub mtha' smra ba'i rigs su gnas pa de/ de'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba dang / dbu ma rang rgyud pa gnyis/ dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni/ dbu ma thal rang gang rung gang zhig nyan rang la stong nyid rtogs pa yod par khas len pa'i rigs su gnas pa de/ de'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa ni/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba dang / 'jig rten grags sde spyod pa'i dbu ma pa/ steng nyid rab tu mi gnas pa'i dbu ma pa gsum don gcig gsum pa dbye na/ grub mtha'i sgo nas dbye ba dang / yul gyi sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ 'gal ba brjod pa'i thal 'gyur gyi sgo nas log smra tshar gcod pa'i dbu ma thal 'gyur ba dang / dgag sgrub spangs te lta ba rtse gcig tu nyams su len pa'i dbu ma thal 'gyur ba gnyis yod/ dang po ni/ slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa/ rigs pa'i khu byug che chung gnyis/ 'grel bshad mkhan po dzā ya anna ta rnams la 'jog gnyis pa ni/ dpal ldan mar me mdzad dang / de'i rjes su 'brang ba/ jo bo bka' gdam pa phal che ba la 'jog ste/ jo bo'i lam sgron las/ chos nyid bden pa gzigs pa yi/ /klu sgrub slob ma zla grags yin/ /de las brgyud pa'i man ngag gis/ /chos nyid bden pa rtogs par 'gyur/ /zhes gsum pa pa ltar ro/ /des na dpal ldan a ti sha de nyid/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lta grub la thugs shin tu mnyes shing / rgya gar na yang / phyi rol pa mtshan mo'i skar ma tsam dang / nang pa nyin mo'i skar ma tsam yin/ nang pa'i yang grub mtha' 'og ma gsum mtshan mo'i skar ma tsam dang / dbu ma pa nyin skar tsam yin/ dbu ma pa la yang / dbu ma rang rgyud pa mtshan mo'i skar ma tsam dang / dbu ma thal 'gyur ba nyin mo'i skar ma tsam yin/

des na thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba 'di shin tu bzang zhing rtogs par dka' bas na/ blor shong ba shin tu nyung bar snang / zhes thal 'gyur ba'i grub mtha' la thugs rtsis che bar mdzad kyang / bod yul du byon pa'i skabs der/ rang rgyud pa'i bshad srol dar ches pa'i stobs kyis/ thal 'gyur gyi bshad srol ha cang dar rgyas su mdzad par ni ma nus la/ 'on kyang thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba nyams su len tshul rnams/ khrid tshul so so'i gseb tshags su bstan pa ni/ bshes gnyen pu to bas mdzad pa'i dpe chos rin spungs dang / be bum sngon po sogs las rtogs par nus so/ /gnyis pa yul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi dbu ma thal 'gyur ba dang / bod gangs can gyi dbu ma thal 'gyur gnyis/ dang po ni sngar bshad pa'i/ sangs rgyas bskyangs dang / zla ba grags pa sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ pa tshab lo tsā ba nyi ma grags bu bzhir bcas dang / 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa/ mkhan chen g.yag pa/ rje red mda' ba sogs la 'jog 'dir pa tshab kyi bu chen bzhi'i ngos 'dzin la/ sgra pa shes rin pas/ grub mtha' kun shes 'grel par/ tshig la mkhas pa gangs pa she'u/ don la mkhas pa gtsang pa sgre sgur/ gnyis ka la mkhas pa rma bya byang rtson/ gnyis ka la mi mkhas pa zhang thang sag pa'o/ /zhes bshad pa ni mi 'thad de/ rma bya byang brtson ni/ rma bya byang ye'i slob ma tsam yin gyi/ pa tshab dngos la ma thug pa'i phyir ro/ /des na pa tshab lo tsā bas/ dbu ma'i stong mthun don drug ma mdzad nas/ slob ma'i gtso bo gangs pa she'u/ gtsang pa sgre sgur/ rma bya byang ye/ zhang thang sag pa bzhi la gsungs zhing / rma bya byang brtson gyis rma bya byang ye la rigs tshogs/ zhang thang sag pa la bzhi brgya pa/ gangs gnyan la pa tshab stong mthun gsan/ yang paṇḍi ta ha su ma ti'i slob ma/ 'grel bshad mkhan po dzā a nan ta nas so/ /khu mdo sde 'bar las brgyud pa'i dbu ma thal 'gyur gyi bshad srol zhes bya ba/

pa tshab las ma brgyud pa'i khu lugs yang gsan te/ thal 'gyur stong thun du grags pa dbu ma de nyid snang ba mdzad pa yin no/ /de ltar rma bya byang brtson gyis dbu ma'i lung rigs rnams bla ma du ma la gsan pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ stong mthun gyi mchod brjod du yang / chos rnams kun la blo yis spyan snga zhing / /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshul khrims dri bsung ldan/ brtse gcig yid kyis bdag gzhan don sgrub pa/ /rgyal mtshungs bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de la rkyang 'dur ba 'tshur ston gzhon seng gis gsan te/ dbu ma gzhung lugs ngan sel mdzad nas/ 'khon sa skya pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / brag dmar ba byang tshul sogs la bshad do zhes pa'i khungs btsun gyi lo rgyus las rtogs par nus so/ /gnyis pa dbu ma rang rgyud pa la/ mtshan nyid sogs gsum las/ dang po ni/ dbu ma thal rang gang rung gang zhig nyan rang la stong nyid rtogs pa med par khas len pa'i rigs su gnas pa de'o/ /gnyis pa khyab mnyam pa ni/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa/ nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa med par 'dod pa'i dbu ma pa/ 'grel pa tshig gsal las/ dbu ma pa yin na ni rang gi rgyud kyi rjes su dpag par bya ba rigs pa ma yin te/ zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi dbu ma pa yin na ni zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos bstan gyi dbu ma pa/ gzhan rtog ge pa 'dis rang nyid rtog ge pa'i bstan bcos la mkhas pa tsam zhig bstan par 'dod pas/ zhes pa'i skabs kyi rtog ge pa/ zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas pa'i dbu ma pa lnga don gcig gsum pa dbye ba la/ grub mtha'i sgo nas dbye ba dang / yul kyi sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la bye brag tu smra ba dang mthun par spyod pa'i dbu ma pa/ mdo sde spyod pa'i dbu ma pa/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang / mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa gang zhig

kun rdzob kyi rnam gzhag phal che ba bye brag tu smra ba dang mthun par khas len pa'i rigs su gnas pa de'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'phags pa grol sde lta bu yin no/ /zhes sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis bshad/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang / mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ dbu ma pa rang rgyud pa gang zhig kun rdzob kyi rnam gzhag phal cher ba mdo sde pa dang mthun par khas len pa'i rigs su gnas pa de/ de'i mtshan nyid yin te/ rim lnga'i 'grel pa kha che'i mkhas pa chen po/ legs smis mdzad pa las/ rgyud dang rkyen las byung ba'i don sogs su grub pa dang / rnam pa dang bcas pa'i shes pa sogs su grub pa ste/ de gnyis ka yang rang bzhin med pa'o/ /zhes mdo sde spyod pa'i dbu ma pa'i de kho na nyid bzung ngo / /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ slob dpon dpal sbas/ slob dpon ye shes snying po/ slob dpon zhi ba mtsho ste gsum la 'jog ces sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams gsungs/ des na mdo sde spyod pa'i dbu ma pa 'dis/ phyi rol gyi don khas len/ phyi don des don rig mngon sum la rang ngos nas rnam pa gtad pa'ang khas len/ phyi don dang / de 'dzin don rig gi shes pa gnyis rdzas gzhan du'ang khas len/ rtags kyi 'god tshul sogs kyang mdo sde pa dang mthun par khas len pas na/ slob dpon de gsum la mdo sde spyod pa'i dbu ma pa zhes 'jog pa ni/ gnad kyi dam pa yin no/ /gsum pa la/ mtshan nyid dang / mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa gang zhig kun rdzob kyi rnam gzhag phal che ba sems tsam pa dang mthun par khas len pa'i rigs su gnas pa de/ de'i mtshan nyid yin te/ sngar gyi rigs lnga'i 'grel pa las phyi'i dngos po ni ye shes kyi ngo bo kho na yin te/ de yang rang bzhin med pa'o zhes rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma pa'i de kho na nyid bzung ngo / /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ mkhan po yang dag rnam snang mdzad du grags pa byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba mtsho/

mkhas pa kā ma la shi la/ 'phags pa grol sde/ rgyal sras seṅge bzang po/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ slob dpon mar me mdzad bzang po rnams la 'jog des na rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma pa des/ phyi don khas mi len cing / gzugs sgra sogs kyis kyang / don rig mngon sum la phyi don rang ngos nas rnam pa gtad pa ma yin gyi/ nang bag chags kyi dbang gis rnam pa gtad pa yin no/ /zhes khas len/ snang ba thams cad kyang sems kyi rnam 'phrul tsam du 'dod pa ni/ 'khrul med gnad kyi dam pa yin no/ /de la khyab mtha' ni/ bye brag tu smra ba dang mthun par spyod pa'i dbu ma pa sogs gsum po gang rung yin na/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa yin pas khyab bo/ /de yang slob dpon legs ldan byed ni/ dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dngos kyi slob ma yin par yongs su grags zhing / slob dpon dpal sbas/ slob dpon ye shes snying po/ slob dpon zhi ba mtsho ste gsum po de rgya gar shar phyogs su 'khrungs pa'i rang rgyud pa'i slob dpon yin pas na/ rang rgyud shar pa go gsum du grags so/ /gnyis pa yul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi dbu ma rang rgyud pa dang / bod gangs can gyi dbu ma rang rgyud pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ slob dpon legs ldan byed sogs sngar gyi rang rgyud pa de rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus kyi bka' cog zhang gsum sogs dang / phyi dar la/ sngog lo chen po/ de'i bu chen bzhi/ bzhi po'i nang nas gro lung pa'i slob ma/ phya pa rjes 'brang bcas pa phal che ba/ khyad par mkhas pa kā ma la shi la'i sku'i skye bar zhal gyis bzhes pa/ kun mkhyen rong ston la sogs pa rnams la der 'jog pa yin no/ /'o na kho bo cag gi 'dren pa dam pa dpal 'bum phrag gsum pa de nyid/ dbu ma thal rang gang gi rjes su 'brang bar mdzad snyam na/ dpal 'bum phrag gsum pa de'i bzhed pa la/

rong ston chen po'i grub mtha' gtso bor bzung ba thun mong gi lugs ni/ dbu ma'i spyi don sogs su lam tsam 'god par mdzad pa de nyid yin la/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i dgongs pa thun mong ma yin pa ni/ 'phags pa klu sgrub lugs kyi spang bya spong tshul du zur tsam gsungs pa de nyid/ paṇa chen rin po che'i thugs bzhed phul du phyin pa yin zhing / thugs sras kyi mchog mkhas pa lha dbang blo gros kyi gsung slob ma 'gas zin bris su bkod pa 'di rnams kyang / paṇa chen rin po che'i gsung rgyun 'khrul med yin par yid ches rnyed pas gnad de dag gis phyir na/ dpal 'bum phrag gsum pa de nyid/ gnas skabs su rang rgyud pa'i grub mtha' yang cung zad gzhed cing / mthar thug dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i grub mtha' mchog tu gyur par bzhed pa yin/ zhes blo gsal rnams kyi nges par bya'o/ /'di dag gi rgyas bshad rnams klu sgrub bstod 'grel las shes par bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa grub mtha' 'dzin tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ dngos smra ba'i tshul bzung ba'i dbu ma pa dang / dbu ma'i grub mtha' dngos su smra ba'i dbu ma pa gnyis/ dang po la/ bre brag tu smra ba'i tshul bzung ste 'dul ba'i gzhung lugs skyang ba'i dbu ma pa/ mdo sde pa'i tshul bzung ste dngos stobs rigs pa'i srol 'byed pa'i dbu ma pa/ sems tsam pa'i tshul bzung ste zab mo sbas don du byed pa'i dbu ma pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ slob dpon yon shag rnam gnyis lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon phyogs glang dang chos grags lta ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ 'phags pa thogs med sku mched lta bu'o/ /de ltar slob dpon yon shaka sogs rnams dbu ma par 'jog pa ni/ dpal 'bum phrag gsum pa'i dgongs pa phul du phyin pa yin zhing / 'phags pa yin na dbu ma pa yin pas khyab pa'i gnad kyang bstan pa yin no/ /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa dbu ma'i grub mtha' dngos su smra ba'i dbu ma pa ni/

dbu ma pa thal rang gi slob dpon rnams la 'jog gsum pa kun rdzob khas len gyi sgo nas dbye na/ don snang dbu ma pa/ sems snang dbu ma pa/ snang tsam gyi dbu ma pa dang gsum yod de/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyis/ gzhung lugs legs bshad las/ kun rdzob gyi sgo nas dbye na/ tha snyad kyi rnam gzhag nyan thos dang mthun par phyi rol gyi don yod par smra ba'i dbu ma pa dang / tha snyad kyi rnam gzhag sems tsam pa dang mthun pa rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma pa dang / tha snyad kyi rnam gzhag gang dang yang mi 'gal bar spyod pa'i dbu ma pa dang gsum yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /dang po don snang dbu ma pa la/ mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ dbu ma yin pa gang zhig tha snyad du phyi rol gyi don khas len pa'i rigs su gnas pa de/ de'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye na/ bye brag tu smra ba dang mthun par spyod pa'i dbu ma pa dang / mdo sde spyod pa'i dbu ma pa gnyis yod/ de gnyis kyi mtshan gzhi ni/ sngar bzhin no/ /gnyis pa sems snang dbu ma pa la/ mtshan nyid dang / rnam grangs gnyis/ dang po ni/ dbu ma pa gang zhig tha snyad du snang ba sems tsam du khas len pa'i rigs su gnas pa de'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de dang rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma pa don gcig gsum pa snang tsam dbu ma pa la/ mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ dbu ma pa gang zhig tha snyad kyi rnam gzhag phal che ba gtso bor 'jig rten na ji ltar grags pa dang mthun par khas len pa'i rigs su gnas pa de/ de'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye na/ snang tsam dbu ma par gyur pa'i gzhung phyi mo'i dbu ma pa dang / der gyur pa'i dbu ma thal 'gyur ba gnyis yod/ dang po ni/ gzhung phyi mo'i dbu ma pa thams cad la 'jog gnyis pa ni/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba dang don gcig des na gzhung phyi mo'i dbu ma pa rnams kyis kun rdzob phal cher 'jig rten na grags pa ltar khas len kyang / de rnams 'jig rten grags sde spyod pa'i dbu ma pa ni ma yin te/

'jig rten grags sde spyod pa'i dbu ma pa yin na dbu ma thal 'gyur ba yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gnad de'i phyir/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba de la tha snyad kyi rnam gzhag gang dang yang mi 'gal bar khas len pa'i dbu ma pa zhes 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ thal 'gyur ba des tha snyad kyi rnam gzhag 'jig rten na grags pa phal cher/ de dang mthun par khas len/ 'jig rten na ma grags la/ bye smra ba la grags pa rnams bye smra ba ltar khas len/ don smra ba la ma grags la sems tsam pa la grags pa 'ga' zhig sems tsam pa ltar khas len pas de skad du 'jog cing / dpal ldan zla bas dbu ma phung po lnga par/ phung po lnga'i rnam gzhag sogs/ bye brag smra ba dang mthun par bshad pa'i gnad kyang de yin no/ /bzhi pa don dam khas len gyi sgo nas dbye na/ dbu ma sgyu ma lta bur smra ba dang / rab tu mi gnas pa'i dbu ma pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ slob dpon arya dāe wa lta bu la 'jog de la dbu ma sgyu ma lta bur smra ba zhes 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad sgro 'dogs gcod byed kyi sgo nas kyang / sgyu ma lta bur khas len/ mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngos nas kyang sgyu ma lta bur khas len/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na yang / gnyis med kyi ye shes dang / sku gsum la sogs pa rnams sgyu ma lta bur khas len pas na/ de la dbu ma sgyu ma lta bur smra ba zhes 'jog pa yin no/ /zhes rje btsun gyis/ ljon shing chen mo las bshad/ 'di ltar du slob dpon dpa' bo yang bzhed pa yin te/ des mdzad pa'i byang sems sgom pa'i man ngag las/ des na ma brtags nyams dga' bar/ /sems ni sgyu ma'i rnam pa ste/ /byang chub kyang ni sgyu ma 'dra/ /zhes bshad pas so/ /sgyu ma rigs grub pa zhes pa yang / sgyu ma lta bur smra ba'i dbu ma pa'i ming gi rnam grangs yin zhing / sgra pa shes rin pas/ sgyu ma rigs grub pa 'di dbu ma rang rgyud par 'chad pa la shes byed med do/

/gnyis pa rab tu mi gnas pa'i dbu ma pa la/ stong nyid rab tu mi gnas pa dang / zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas pa'i dbu ma pa gnyis/ dang po dang dbu ma thal 'gyur ba don gcig gnyis pa dang dbu ma rang rgyud pa don gcig ste/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyis/ thub pa dgongs gsal las/ rang rgyud pa zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas pa bsgom/ thal 'gyur pa stong nyid rab tu mi gnas pa bsgom/ zhes gsungs pas so/ /'dir gnad kyi gtso bo ni dbu ma thal 'gyur ba de la/ snang sel dbu ma pa zhes 'jog ste/ des gtso bor snang ba snang yul la 'khrul pa'i log shes kyi yul gyi gtso bo 'gog cing / shin tu dpyad pa'i tshe snang ba tsam yang khas mi len pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la rgyal ba'i yum gyi dbu ma pa zhes rim lnga'i 'grel par bshad do/ /dbu ma rang rgyud pa de la/ rtags sel dbu ma pa zhes bya ste/ des gtso bor zhen pa zhen yul la 'khrul ba'i log shes kyi yul gtso bo 'gog cing / shin tu dpyad pa'i tshe yang snang ba tsam zhig khas len pa'i phyir ro/ /'di dag gi rgyas bshad rnams 'og tu 'chad/ lnga pa sgra'i brjod rigs kyi sgo nas/ rang stong dbu ma pa dang / gzhan stong dbu ma pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba gsum/ dang po ni/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' smra ba gang zhig gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi de bzhin nyid bden stong du khas len pa'i rigs gnas de'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de dang dbu pa ma don gcig gsum pa dbye na/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi dbu ma rang stong pa dang / bod gangs can gyi khrod kyi dbu ma rang stong pa gnyis yod/ gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba gang zhig gnyis stong gi de bzhin nyid rang gi ngo bos mi stong bar bden grub tu khas len pa'i rigs su gnas pa de'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de dang / sems tsam rnam rdzun pa don gcig gsum pa dbye na/

rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi dbu ma gzhan stong pa dang / bod gangs can gyi gzhan stong pa gnyis yod/ bzhi pa dngos brtags dpyod pa ni/ dbu ma gzhan stong pa yin na/ dbu ma pa ma yin dgos te/ de yin na sems tsam rnam rdzun pa yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /dbu ma pa'i rnam gzhag 'di rnams kyang khungs dang 'brel ba'i legs bshad kho na yin no/ /de dag gi skabs su dogs pa dpyad na/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba yang yin/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa yod par thal/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i gzhung yang yin/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i gzhung yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ dbu ma thal 'gyur pa'i rang gzhung yang yin/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i rang gzhung yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ ma grub na/ der thal/ dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab de de yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ dang po gang zhig phyi ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba de rtsa ba shes rab rang gzhung du byas nas 'chad pa po'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags sla/ rtags gnyis pa des mtshon/ ma khyab tsam la/ bsal pa der thal/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i dbu ma'i lta ba yang yin/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i dbu ma'i lta ba yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ dbu ma thal rang gnyis kyi thun mong gi dbu ma'i lta ba yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ dbu ma thal rang gnyis kyi thun mong du gtan la 'bebs pa'i dbu ma'i lta ba yod pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ ma grub na/ der thal/ chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pa'i lta ba de/ de yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ dbu ma'i lta ba gang zhig dbu ma thal 'gyur bas kyang khyod gtan la 'bebs/ dbu ma rang rgyud pas kyang khyod gtan la 'bebs pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i lta ba yin pa'i phyir te/

chos can gyis 'grub/ rtags gnyis pa ma grub na/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba chos can/ khyod der thal la/ khyod chos thams cad bden med du gtan la 'bebs pa po'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod dbu ma pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis po'ang des mtshon to/ /gal te dbu ma rang rgyud pa de dbu ma pa min zer na/ de chos can/ khyod der thal/ de dang dngos smra ba gang rung gang zhig dngos smra ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' smra ba'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod bden grub 'dod pa'i gang zag tu thal lo/ /'dod na/ de chos can/ de min par thal/ chos can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / 'phags pa klu sgrub chos can/ khyod gzhung phyi mo'i dbu ma pa ma yin par thal/ khyod grub mtha' phyogs 'dzin gyi dbu ma pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de der thal/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis bzhed pa'i dbu ma'i lta ba de/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba dang mthun par gnas pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ ma grub na/ der thal/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba de/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dgongs don phyin ci ma log pa rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa de de ltar yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags sla/ ma khyab tsam la/ 'phags pa klu sgrub bzhed pa'i dbu ma'i lta ba de/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba dang mthun par gnas pa ma yin par thal/ de lta bu de/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i lta ba dang mthun par gnas pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de der thal/ slob dpon legs ldan byed de/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dgongs don phyin ci ma log par 'grel ba po'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ rtsa ba shes rab kyi dgongs 'grel du 'grel pa shes rab sgron me'i phreng ba rtsom pa po yin pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/

rtags der thal/ chos can dang gcig yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang slob dpon dbyig gnyen chos can/ khyod dbu ma pa yin par thal/ khyod theg chen 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod sa brgyad pa thob pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ 'jam dpal rtsa brgyud las/ sa ni rgya mtsho gnyis mthar thug /thams cad kyi ni rgyan du byas/ /zhes pa des/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen de sa brgyad pa thob pa'i gang zag tu lung bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod rten 'brel gyi gnas lugs zab mo rtogs pa'i gang zag tu thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod de ma yin par thal/ khyod chos thams cad bden med du ston pa'i yi ge tsam thos pas 'jigs te rten 'brel zab mo ston pa'i dbu ma'i bstan bcos rgyang ring du spangs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de der thal/ 'jug 'grel las/ gal te gnas brtan dbyig gnyen dang / phyogs kyi glang po dang / chos skyong la sogs pa bstan bcos rnams kyi mdzad pa po byon zin par gyur pa de dag gis kyang stong nyid ston pa'i snod du ma gyur ba rnams nges don zab mo'i yi ge tsam thos pas 'jigs su dogs te/ slob dpon de dag gi gzhung rnams las rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba phyin ci la log par ston pa 'di spangs sam zhe na/ de skad du smra'o/ /zhes pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir zer na ma khyab bo/ /rang lugs gzhung de'i don/ slob dpon thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ phyogs kyi glang po/ dpal ldan chos skyong rnams kyis gnas lugs kyi don ma gzigs zhes pa'i don ma yin gyi/ slob dpon de dag gis mdzad pa'i mdo'i gzhung lugs rnams las/ rten 'brel zab mo'i gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par bshad pa med ces pa'i don yin te/ de lta bu'i gzhung rnams ni dngos smra ba'i rang gzhung yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang dpal ldan chos skyong gis mdzad pa'i mdo'i gzhung rnams las/

rten 'brel zab mo'i gnas lugs ma bshad pa yin mod/ des mdzad pa'i sngags kyi gzhung las rten 'brel gyi gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par bshad pa yod de/ gsung ngag rdo rje'i tshig rkang las de ltar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /'di rnams rig lam skyong tshul shin tu go bde ba yin pas/ blo gsal mkhas pa rnams kyis shin tu nges par bya dgos so/ /'grel pa 'di'i sogs khong nas 'phags pa thogs med kyang 'don pa/ rje btsun red mda' pas dbu ma'i ṭīkkar bshad pa ni don dang mthun zhing / paṇa shaka pas/ sogs khong nas 'phags pa thogs med 'don rgyu min gsung ba ni/ shing rta'i srol 'byed gnyis kyi gzhung lugs kyi dgos don mthar thug pa/ dbu ma gzhan stong du mthun par smras pa de'i dpung gnyen 'tshol ba tsam du snang ngo / /'dir gnad kyi snying po cung zad bshad na/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pas 'jug 'grel du bshad pa lta bu zhig dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i gzhung lugs rnams las kyang bshad de/ slob dpon legs ldan byed kyis rtog ge 'bar ba las/ rang gi lugs kyi nga rgyal gyis/ /mkhas par rlom gzhan 'di skad smra/ /de nyid bdud rtsir 'jug pa ni/ /rnal 'byor spyod pas legs par bstan/ /theg pa chen po pa nyid kyi slob dpon thogs med dang dbyig gnyen la sogs pa gzhan dag ni/ de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan cing / sa rab tu dga' ba brnyes pa'i 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis legs par rtogs pa'i theg pa chen po'i lugs gzhan du 'dren par byed cing / ngo tsha dang khrel med pa don rnam par mi shes bzhin du shes par nga rgyal bar byed pa dag 'di skad du smra ste/ de kho na nyid kyi bdud rtsir 'jug pa de ni/ bdag cag kho nas legs par bstan gyis gzhan dbu mar smra ba rnams kyis ni ma yin no/ /zhes smra'o/ /zhes thogs med sku mched kyis rgyal ba'i bka'i dgongs pa 'grel tshul de/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi 'grel tshul dang gtan nas mi mthun pa kho nar bshad/

slob kā ma la shi las dbu ma snang ba las kyang / 'on kyang 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas rigs pa'i sgron me'i tshogs rnam pa du mas/ 'di gsal bar rab tu brjod na/ de'i stobs kyis kyang ci'i phyir khas mi len/ de nyid kyi phyir slob dpon de ni bcom ldan 'das kyis stong pa nyid de ston pa'i phyir dang / sa dang po thob pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa lang kar gshegs pa la sogs pa las lung bstan to/ /gal te 'dis log par ston par 'gyur na ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de ltar lung ston par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir slob dpon gyi tshig spangs na bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' spangs pa kho nar 'gyur ro/ /de lta bas na de'i lung dang ldan pas 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas bstan pa'i lam bor nas 'phags pa ma yin pa'i skye bos rab tu bstan pa la brten par mi bya'o/ /zhes 'phags pa thogs med sku mched kyi gzhung lugs sgra ji bzhin du smra ba'i sems tsam pa rnams kyis/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis rgyal ba'i bka'i dgongs pa 'grel tshul de tshad ma min zhes 'dod pa la lung dang rigs pas 'gog tshul mang du gsungs so/ /des na shing rta'i srol 'byed gnyis kyi gzhung lugs kyi dgongs don gyi lta ba kha cig dbu ma rang rgyud du mthun zhes dang / kha cig thal 'gyur du mthun zhes dang / kha cig gzhan stong du mthun zhes 'dod pa rnams ni/ dbu ma thal rang gi slob dpon chen po rnams kyi gzhung lugs la ma brtags par rang dgar smra ba tsam du zad do/ /gnad des na rang gi lugs/ 'phags pa thogs med sku mched sogs kyis/ rang ngos nas dbu ma'i lta ba mngon sum du rtogs kyang / kha cig gzhan stong du mthun zhes/ de dag gis mdzad pa'i gzhung lugs rnams su dbu ma'i lta ba phyin ci ma log par bkral ba med ces khas len pa 'di/ bdag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa'i bzhed pa phul du phyin pa yin no/

/de la kho na re/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen chos can/ dbu ma pa ma yin par thal/ sems tsam pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de der thal/ 'phags pa thogs med des slob dpon dbyig gnyen rjes su gzung ba'i don du/ rgyal ba'i yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi don sems tsam pa dang mthun par bkral ba'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ ma grub na/ der thal/ 'grel pa don gsal gyi 'grel bshad tshigs gsal las/ 'phags pa thogs med sa gsum pa 'od byed pa brnyes su zin kyang / slob dpon dbyig gnyen 'dul ba'i don du rgyal ba'i yum gyi don sems tsam du bkral to/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rang lugs lung de'i don/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen de/ sngon sems tsam yin pa'i don du 'chad dgos so/ /gzhan yang / dbu ma rang rgyud par gyur pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa yod par thal/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i lta ba la brten nas nyan thos dgra bcom pa thob pa yod pa'i phyir te/ bar du bdag zlog gi dbu ma'i lta ba la brten nas nyan thos dgra bcom pa go 'phang thob pa yod pa gang zhig bar du bdag zlog gi dbu ma'i lta ba de/ dbu ma thal rang gnyis kyi thun mong du gtan la 'bebs pa'i lta ba yin pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis sla/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag tu thal/ khyod 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod khyod rang gis stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs par khas len gyi gang zag tu thal/ khyod khyod rang gang zhig khyod stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi dbu ma rang rgyud pas nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod par khas len par thal/ khyod kyi dbu ma rang rgyud par gyur pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pas chos kyi bdag med mngon sum rtogs par khas len pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod na/ dbu ma rang rgyud pas/

nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod par khas len par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ slob dpon legs ldan byed kyis de ltar khas len par thal lo/ /'dod na/ 'grel pa tshig gsal las/ slob dpon legs ldan byed ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams la ji skad du bshad pa'i stong pa nyid rtogs pa yod par ma mthong nas/ zhes bshad pa mi 'thad par thal lo/ /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa khas blang bya dbu ma 'chad pa la/ dbu ma la/ mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ chos dbyings rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can de/ dbu ma'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa ni/ de dang / dbu ma'i lta ba/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba rnams don gcig gsum pa la/ sgra'i brjod rigs kyi sgo nas dbye ba/ gnyis tshan gyi sgo nas dbye ba nas/ bcu tshan gyi sgo nas dbye ba'i bar bcu yod/ dang po la/ gzhung dbu ma/ lam dbu ma/ 'bras bu dbu ma dang gsum yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba/ dngos brtags dpyad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ lam dbu mas rtogs par bya ba'i chos de/ de'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa ni/ de dang shes bya don gcig gsum pa la/ kun rdzob bden pa dang / don dam bden pa gnyis so/ /bzhi pa ni/ gzhi dbu ma yin na/ dbu ma yin pas kyang ma khyab/ ma yin pas kyang ma khyab pa ni go sla'o/ /gnyis pa lam dbu ma la/ mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i sems can gyi mkhyen pa de'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de dang sems can gyi rgyud kyi lam don gcig gsum pa dbye na/ nyan thos kyi lam/ rang rgyal gyi lam/ theg chen gyi slob lam dang gsum yod des na/ lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi dbu ma'i lta ba de/ dbu ma yin kyang / lam dbu ma ma yin zhes khas len pa ni/ dpal 'bum phrag gsum pa'i dgongs pa phul du phyin pa yin no/ /lam dbu ma yin na/ dbu ma yin pas ma khyab ste/ lam du gyur pa'i gtso bo sems de lam dbu ma yin kyang dbu ma ma yin pa'i phyir ro/

/gsum pa 'bras bu dbu ma la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba/ dngos brtags dpyad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i zung 'jug gi sku de'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de dang sangs rgyas kyi sku don gcig gsum pa dbye na/ sku bzhi yod/ bzhi pa ni/ rtogs ye chos sku de la/ dbu ma mtshan nyid pa yin min gnyis yod/ sku gzhan gsum po gang rung yin na/ dbu ma min pas khyab/ gnyis tshan gyi sgo nas dbye na/ zhi lhag gnyis kyi dbu ma/ tshogs gnyis kyi dbu ma/ thabs shes gnyis kyi dbu ma dang gsum yod/ gsum tshan gyi sgo nas dbye na/ bslab pa gsum gyi dbu ma/ rnam thar sgo gsum gyi dbu ma/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi dbu ma dang gsum yod/ bzhi tshan gyi sgo nas dbye na/ rnal 'byor pa bzhi'i dbu ma/ sbyor ba bzhi'i dbu ma/ sgrub pa bzhi'i dbu ma/ bsam gtan bzhi'i dbu ma/ tshan med bzhi'i dbu ma rnams su yod/ lnga tshan gyi sgo nas dbye na/ rnal 'byor pa lnga'i dbu ma/ dbang po lnga'i dbu ma/ stobs lnga'i dbu ma sogs yod/ drug tshan gyi sgo nas dbye na/ phar phyin drug gi dbu ma/ rjes dran drug gi dbu ma sogs yod/ bdun tshan gyi sgo nas dbye na/ byang chub yan lag bdun gyi dbu ma/ 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyi dbu ma sogs yod/ brgyad tshan gyi sgo nas dbye na/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi dbu ma/ snyoms 'jug brgyad kyi dbu ma sogs yod/ dgu tshan gyi sgo nas dbye na/ mthar gnas snyoms 'jug dgu'i dbu ma/ sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu'i dbu ma sogs yod/ bcu tshan gyi sgo nas dbye na/ phar phyin bcu'i dbu ma/ sa bcu'i dbu ma sogs yod do/ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa/ 'dir bstan 'jug bya'i dbu ma sogs gzung ba ni/ spyir dbu ma rigs tshogs drug po de bstan bcos 'di'i 'jug bya'i dbu ma yin zhing / khyad par dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab de/ bstan bcos 'di'i 'jug bya'i dbu ma'i gtso bo yin te/

'jug 'grel las/ dbu ma'i bstan bcos la 'jug par bya ba'i phyir dbu ma la 'jug pa rtsom par 'dod pas zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i skabs su dogs pa cung zad dpyad na/ gzhi grub na/ rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba yin dgos par thal/ gzhi grub na/ gzhi dbu ma yin dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mthar 'dzin gyi lta ba chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ de ma yin par thal/ rtag chad kyi mthar lhung ba yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ rtag chad gang rung gi mthar lhung ba'i lta ba yin pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ rtag mthar lhung ba'i lta ba yin pa'i phyir te/ /chos can gyis 'grub/ gal srid mthar 'dzin gyi lta ba de rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba min zer na/ de chos can/ khyod der thal/ khyod mtha' bral gyi chos yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ gzhi dbu ma bden gnyis zung 'jug yin pa'i phyir/ gzhi grub ba'i phyir ro/ gzhan yang / lam yin na/ lam dbu ma yin dgos par thal/ dbu ma yin na/ dbu ma'i lta ba yin dgos pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ ma grub na/ der thal/ de gnyis don gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod na/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags sla/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ de ma yin par thal/ 'bras bu dbu ma yin pa'i phyir te/ mthar thug gi sku yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'jug bya'i dbu ma yin na/ dbu ma yin dgos par thal/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'jug bya'i bstan bcos yin na/ bstan bcos yin dgos pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ dbu ma'i bstan bcos la 'jug par bya ba'i zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i dbu ma'i bstan bcos yin na/ dbu ma'i bstan bcos yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /rang lugs rtags ma grub zer ro/ /rtsa bar 'dod na/ dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/

de der thal/ dbu ma 'jug pa de/ dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab la zab pa dang rgya che ba gnyis kyi sgo nas 'jug pa'i bstan bcos yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod dbu ma'i lta ba yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ khyod ngag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa bar ma khyab na/ dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags chos can dang gcig yin pa'i phyir gyis 'grub/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ bstan bcos ma yin par thal/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de der thal/ 'phags pa klu sgrub de sangs rgyas 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ khyod stobs bcu mi 'jigs pa bzhi brnyes pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pas 'grel pa sgron gsal las/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas/ nyid kyis don rjes su brnyes nas so so rang rig pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ting nge 'dzin 'jig rten du bstan te/ lha dang mi'i bde ba las 'das zhing / mu stegs dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i bde ba las 'das nas/ skye ba dang 'gag pa dang bral ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa/ lta bas chog mi shes pa stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams kyis brgyan pa brnyes nas bde ba can du gshegs pa ste/ yon tan gyi dbang phyug brgyad dang ldan par bzhugs so/ /zhes pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir gnad kyi snying po cung zad brjod na/ dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub de/ lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo dang / sprin chen po'i mdo dang / rnga bo che'i mdo dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud sogs mdo rgyud mang po nas lung bstan zhing / lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo'i dngos bstan la/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba tsam brnyes par bshad/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/

sa drug pa brnyes par bshad mod/ don la sgron gsal gyi lung de'i dngos bstan la/ slob dpon 'di nyid sangs rgyas dngos su bshad pa yin te/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ting nge 'dzin 'jig rten du bstan te/ zhes pas/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa brnyes pa dngos su bstan/ lha dang mi'i bde ba las 'das zhing zhes pa nas/ snyoms par 'jug pa'i bde ba las 'das nas zhes pa'i bar gyis/ 'jig rten pa'i bde ba dang / mu stegs kyi lta ba dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lam las 'das te/ bla na med pa'i byang chub brnyes pa dngos su bstan/ skye ba dang 'gag pa dang bral ba'i zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams kyis brgyan pa brnyes nas zhes pa'i bar rnams kyis/ sku bzhi char brnyes pa dngos su bstan/ dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad dang ldan par bzhugs so/ /zhes pas slob dpon de nyid bdud bzhi bcom zhing dbang phyug gi yon tan drug brgyad dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das su dngos su bstan pa yin pas/ dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub de nyid la gus pa chen po byed pa ni/ legs pa thams cad kyi rgyu'i gtso bo yin no/ /zhes shes par bya'o/ /de la kha cig 'di snyam du/ sgron gsal gyi lung de sngags lugs yin pas/ 'dir khas mi len snyam na/ 'o na 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud kyi lung drangs nas/ slob dpon 'di nyid skyes bu tshad mar sgrub pa yang mi 'thad par 'gyur ro/ /des na lang kar gshegs pa sogs su/ sa dang po brnyes par bshad pa ni/ slob dpon des thog mar 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang mnos pa'i tshe/ 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom zhing de dang dus mnyam par bdud gzhan gsum yang bcom nas dang po nyid du sa dang po rab tu dga' ba tsam brnyes pa la dgongs pa yin la/ skal ldan cig char ba'i skyes bu de lta bus lo drug brgya'i bar du bzhugs te/ tshe gcig lus gcig la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang ma brnyes na/

tshe gcig lus gcig la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob pa yod ces pa yang ming tsam du 'gyur ro/ /yang de la kha cig 'di snyam du/ 'phags pa klu sgrub des bde ba can du gshegs nas/ slar 'jig rten 'dir byon nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas pa yin no snyam na/ de yang ma yin te/ 'jig rten 'dir lo drug brgya tsam bzhugs pa'i dus su/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams brnyes nas/ slar bde ba can du gshegs pa yin par/ sgron gsal nyid las bshad pa'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ stobs bcu dang mi 'jig pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams kyis brgyan pa brnyes nas/ bde ba can du gshegs pa ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnad des na dpal ldan zla ba grags pa yang / 'phags klu sgrub kyis thog mar 'jig rten 'dir lo drug brgya bzhugs pa'i dus kyi slob ma ni ma yin te/ 'jug 'grel dang 'grel bshad sogs kyi tshig rigs la brtags pas cung zad dus mi mtshungs par shin tu gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir dang / chos kyi rje sa skya paṇḍi tas dris lan las kyang de ltar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang phyis dag pa'i snang ba las 'jal ba'am/ thugs rje'i dbang gis dbu dang / sku lus je nye je nyer song ba 'byar ba la/ thugs rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes slar yang bzhugs te/ 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i skabs kyi dngos kyi slob ma gung yin par gdon mi za ba yin te/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi chos bskor rnams dang / dbu ma'i lta khrid kyi brgyud rim sogs las/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ zla ba grags pa zhes brgyud pa bar ma chad par bshad 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /blo gsal mkhas pa'i tshogs rnams kyis legs bshad 'di nyid snying gi ze 'brur bcang bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang sher phyin gyi mdo de nges don gyi mdo yin par thal/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pas sher phyin gyi mdo nges don gyi mdor bkral ba'i phyir te/

'jug pa las/ shes rab pha rol phyin tshul las/ /de dag de skad rab tu bsgrags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ nges don gyi mdo ma yin par thal/ drang don gyi mdo yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de der thal/ 'phags pa thogs med des sher phyin gyi mdo drang don gyi mdor bkral ba gang zhig 'phags pa thogs med de drang nges 'byed pa po tshad ldan yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ 'phags pa thogs med de chos can/ der thal/ khyod bka' dang po dang / bar pa gnyis drang don du bkral nas/ bka' tha ma nges don gyi mdor 'grel ba po'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod sems tsam pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi slob dpon yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can dang gcig yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags gnyis pa ma grub na/ der thal/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ thogs med zhes bya'i dge slong 'byung / /mdo sde drang don nges pa'i don/ /rnam pa mang po de yis 'byed/ /ces pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir ro zer na/ ma khyab bo/ /gzhung de'i don ni/ slob dpon des nges don gyi mdo mang po'i dgongs pa yang 'grel/ drang don gyi mdo mang po'i dgongs pa yang 'grel zhes pa'i don yin te/ slob dpon des/ sher phyin gyi mdo nyi khri'i dgongs pa 'grel ba la/ nyi khri de nyid rnam nges mdzad cing / bka' mtha' ma'i dgongs 'grel du/ sa sde lnga/ sdom rnams gnyis rnams mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na sems tsam pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi slob dpon yin na/ sems tsam pa yin pas ma khyab pa dang / dngos smra ba'i tshul bzung pa'i slob dpon yin na/ dngos smra ba yin pas ma khyab pa sogs khas len pa ni/ gnad kyi dam pa yin no/ dbu ma pa dang dbu ma'i rnam gzhag dang / /'jug bya'i dbu ma ngos 'dzin rnam pa gsum/ /ji bzhin 'chad pa kho bo'i man ngag ste/ /blo gsal mkhas rnams 'di bzhin nges par mdzod/ ༈ nyan thos sangs rgyas 'bring rnams thub dbang skyes/

/zhes sogs kyi skabs su ngag sbyor dang / mthar dpyad gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pas bstan bcos dbu ma la 'jug pa rtsom pa'i thog mar rgyal sras rgyu gsum la bstod phyag mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rgyal sras rgyu gsum po de mngon mtho dang nges legs thams cad thob pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ rgyal sras rgyu gsum gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa dang / snying rje gsum gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ de so so'i mtshan nyid dang / khyab mnyam/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ rang 'bras rgyal sras rgyu gsum gang rung gang zhig sems can sdug bsngal las bral 'dod kyi rnam pa can de/ de gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i snying rje tshad med kyi mtshan nyid/ yang de gsum gang rung gang zhig rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i theg chen gyi lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i gtso bo rnam rig de/ de gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i byang chub sems kyi mtshan nyid/ yang rang 'bras de gsum gang rung gang zhig rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i chos nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba de de gsum gyi zlas phye ba gnyis med kyi blo gros kyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa khyab mnyam pa rim bzhin/ rang 'bras de gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i snying rje tshad med/ snying rje'i sems dang gnyis su med blo dang / zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi snying rje'i sems dang zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i snying rje tshad med rnams don gcig yang rang 'bras de gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i byang chub kyi sems/ theg chen sems bskyed/ byang chub sems ni zhes pa'i byang chub kyi sems rnams don gcig yang rang 'bras de gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i gnyis med kyi blo gros/ dbu ma'i lta ba/ gnyis su med blo dang zhes pa'i gnyis med kyi blo gros gsum don gcig gsum pa dbye ba rim bzhin/ de gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i snying rje tshad med la dbye na lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi snying rje tshad med dang /

lam zhugs kyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi de gnyis yod/ lam zhugs kyi de la/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ byang sems/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi de bzhi yod/ de gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i byang chub kyi sems la dbye na/ theg chen tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi de nas/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi byang chub sems kyi bar lnga yod/ yang de gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i gnyis med kyi blo gros la dbye na/ lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi de nas/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ byang sems/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi de lnga yod/ bzhi pa sa mtshams ni/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po lcags thang ba'i gsung rgyun ltar/ bdag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa 'di ltar bzhed de/ de gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i snying rje tshad med ni/ lam ma zhugs nas/ sangs rgyas pa'i bar na yod/ de gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i byang chub kyi sems ni/ theg chen tshogs lam thob ma thag pa nas/ sangs rgyas pa'i bar na yod/ de gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i gnyis med kyi blo gros ni/ lam ma zhugs nas/ sangs rgyas pa'i bar na yod/ gnyis pa snying rje gsum gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa la/ tshad med bzhi'i rnam gzhag spyir bstan dang / snying rje tshad med bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po 'chad pa la/ byams pa tshad med/ snying rje tshad med/ dga' ba tshad med/ btang snyoms tshad med dang bzhi/ de bzhi la so so'i mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ de bzhi gang rung gang zhig sems can thams cad bde ba bde ba'i rgyud dang ldan par 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi blo de byams pa tshad med kyi mtshan nyid/ de bzhi gang rung gang zhig sems can sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi blo de/ snying rje tshad med kyi mtshan nyid/ de bzhi gung gang zhig sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi blo de/ dga' ba tshad med kyi mtshan nyid/

de bzhi gang rung gang zhig sems can nye ring chags sdang dang 'bral bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi blo de btang snyoms tshad med kyi mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye na/ byams pa tshad med de la dbye na/ sems can la dmigs pa'i byams pa tshad med/ chos la dmigs pa'iྎ dmigs med la dmigs pa'i byams pa tshad med dang gsum yod/ phyi ma rnams la yang ming brjes te rigs 'gre/ gnyis pa snying rje tshad med bye brag tu bshad pa la/ de la/ mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshad med bzhi po gang rung gang zhig sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi blo de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa dbye na/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med/ chos la dmigs pa'iྎ dmigs med la dmigs pa'i de gsum yod/ de gsum la mtshan nyid dang / dmigs yul ngos bzung ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ snying rje tshad med gsum po gang rung gang zhig sdug bsngal gyi mnar ba'i sems can la dmigs nas de dag sdug bsngal las bskyob par 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi blo de/ de gsum gyi zlas phye pa'i sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med kyi mtshan nyid/ de gsum gang rung gang zhig sems can rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi bdag gis stong par rtogs pa'i sgo nas mi rtag pa'i khyad par du byas pa'i sems can la dmigs nas de dag sdug bsngal las skyob par 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi blo de/ de gsum gyi zlas phye pa'i chos la dmigs pa'i de'i mtshan nyid/ de gsum gang rung gang zhig sems can thams cad bden med du rtogs pa'i sgo nas bde med kyi khyad par du byas pa'i sems can la dmigs nas de dag sdug bsngal las skyob par 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi blo de/ de gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i gsum pa'i mtshan nyid yin no/ /'dir skabs su dogs pa dpyad na/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam thob ma thag pa'i gang zag chos can/

khyod rang rgyu rgyal sras rgyu gsum las 'khrungs ma thag pa'i rgyal sras yin par thal/ rgyal sras yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod khyod rang gi nyer len du gyur pa'i rgyal sras rgyu gsum las 'khrungs ma thag pa'i rgyal sras yin par thal lo zer na/ ma khyab/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi nyer len du gyur pa'i rgyal sras rgyu gsum yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi nyer len du gyur pa'i byang chub kyi sems yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi nyer len du gyur pa'i theg chen sems bskyed yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam thob kha ma'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi theg chen sems bskyed yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de med par thal/ theg chen sems bskyed yin na/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam thob pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi theg chen sems bskyed yin dgos pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / snying rje tshad med de/ byang chub kyi sems dang gnyis med kyi blo gros gnyis kyi rgyu yin par thal/ de ltar yin no zhes ston par byed pa la/ 'jug pa rang 'grel las/ byang chub kyi sems dang gnyis su med pa'i blo gros gnyis kyi rtsa ba yang snying rje yin pa'i phyir na zhes pa'i gzhung 'di byung ba'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rgyal sras rgyu gsum las 'khrungs ma thag pa'i rgyal sras de kho kho rang yin par thal/ de yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod rgyal sras rgyu gsum gyi dngos 'bras yin par thal/ khyod de las 'khrungs ma thag pa'i rgyal sras yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod snying rje tshad med kyi dngos 'bras yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dir ma khyab/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ de min par thal/ de'i rgyu 'bras yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod byang chub kyi sems dang /

gnyis med kyi blo gros gnyis kyi dngos 'bras gang zhig de gnyis snying rje tshad med kyi dngos 'bras yin pa'i phyir te/ dang po der thal/ khyod rgyal sras rgyu gsum gyi dngos 'bras yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ma grub na/ de der thal/ snying rje tshad med de gnyis kyi dngos rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dngos/ gzhan yang / theg chen mthong lam pa chos can/ khyod rang rgyur gyur pa'i theg chen tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal sras rgyu gsum las 'khrungs pa'i rgyal sras yin par thal/ khyod kyi rgyur gyur pa'i theg chen tshogs lam pa yod pa gang zhig khyod kyi rgyur gyur pa'i de'i rgyud kyi rgyal sras rgyu gsum yod pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi rgyur gyur pa'i theg chen tshogs lam pa yod par thal/ khyod byang sems 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ma grub na/ de'i rgyur gyur pa'i de chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud kyi rgyal sras rgyu gsum yod par thal/ khyod lam rgyud ldan gyi byang sems yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de der thal/ theg chen tshogs lam pa de/ lam rgyud ldan gyi byang sems yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod rang rgyur gyur pa'i theg chen tshogs lam pa las skyes pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod rang rgyur gyur pa'i theg chen tshogs lam pa las skyes ma thag pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig de las skyes zin skyes pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod de'i dngos 'bras yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ de'i rgyud 'bras yin pa'i phyir ro/ /phyi ma ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod de las so so skye bor skyes zin skyes pa yin par thal/ de las skyes zin skyes pa'i gang zag gang zhig de las theg chen 'phags par skyes zin skyes pa yin pa'i phyir/

'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod de las so so skye bor skyes pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ so so skye bor skyes pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod so so skye bo yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ma grub na/ theg chen 'phags pa skyes zin skyes pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod theg chen 'phags pa thob zin thob pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ de thob ma thag pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi mthong lam thob ma thag pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod thob ma thag pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod khyod rang gang zhig khyod lam zhugs kyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / snying rje tshad med de rgyal ba'i lo tog phun gsum tshogs pa bskyed pa la thog mtha' bar gsum du gal che ba'i snying rje yin par thal/ gang phyir brtse nyid rgyal pa'i lo tog phun tshogs 'di/ /zhes sogs kyis gzhung don grub pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod de bskyed par byed pa la/ dang por gal che ba sa bon dang chos mtshungs/ bar du gal che ba chu lud drod gsher sogs dang chos mtshungs/ tha mar gal che ba lo tog smin nas longs spyod pa dang chos mtshungs pa'i snying rje yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab bo/ /'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod de bskyed pa la dang por gal che ba sa bon dang chos mtshungs pa'i snying rje yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi snying rje yin par thal lo/ /'dod na/ min par thal/ sangs rgyas pa'i snying rje yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod de bskyed pa la tha mar gal che ba 'bras bu smin nas longs spyod pa dang chos mtshungs pa'i snying rje yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dngos/ gzhan yang / snying rje tshad med yin na/

rgyal sras rgyu gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i snying rje tshad med yin dgos par thal/ theg chen sems bskyed yin na/ rgyal sras rgyu gsum gyi zlas phyi ba'i byang chub kyi sems yin dgos pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ de yin na/ rang 'bras rgyal sras rgyu gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i byang chub kyi sems yin dgos pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab bo/ /rtsa bar 'dod na/ rgyal sras dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i snying rje tshad med chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ chos can kho rang yin pa'i phyir te/ de yod pa'i phyir/ rtsar 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod rgyal sras kyi rgyu yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod rgyal sras kyi snga logs su byung par thal lo/ /rtsa bar ma khyab na/ rgyal sras dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i theg chen sems bskyed chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ bsgrub tshul sngar dang 'dra/ 'dir rang lugs pa kha cig gis/ rgyal sras rgyu gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i theg chen sems bskyed kyi sa mtshams/ theg chen tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i snga logs de ma thag pa'i bar na yod zhes bshad pa ni/ mi 'thad de/ 'o na nyon cig sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi theg chen sems bskyed las 'khrungs ma thag pa'i rgyal sras med par thal/ khyod kyi rgyal sras rgyu gsum gyi sa mtshams 'jog tshul de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de yod par thal/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi rnam mkhyen las 'khrungs ma thag pa'i rgyal sras yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa las 'khrungs ma thag pa'i rgyal sras yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thar/ rgyas sras kyi dngos rgyur gyur pa'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod de dngos rgyur gyur pa'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa yod par thal/ khyod rgyal sras yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi snying rje tshad med las 'khrungs ma thag pa'i rgyal sras yod par thal/

sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi snying rje tshad med kyi bdag rkyen byas pa la brten nas byung ba'i rgyal sras yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi snying rje tshad med kyi bdag rkyen byas pa la brten nas rgyal sras la lung gi chos 'khor bskor ba yod pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i dngos kyi gdul byar gyur pa'i rgyal sras yod pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir/ rgyal sras rgyu gsum gyi sa mtshams mkhas pa gzhan dag gi 'dod tshul la dpyad pa rnams ni/ ngag las rtogs par bya'o/ /'dir gzhung gi don la cung zad dpyad na/ nyan thos 'phags pa yin na/ nyan thos sangs rgyas 'bring rnams thub dbang skyes zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi nyan thos zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i nyan thos yin dgos par thal/ rang rgyal 'phags pa yin na/ gzhung de'i tshig zur gyi sangs rgyas 'bring rnams zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i rang rgyal yin dgos pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ de'i tshig zur gyi sangs rgyas 'bring rnams zhes pa des rang sangs rgyas dngos su bstan pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ ma grub na/ der thal/ 'jug 'grel las/ sangs rgyas kyi sgra 'di sangs rgyas kyi de nyid/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gsum car la yang 'jug ste/ des na sangs rgyas kyi sgras rang sangs rgyas dag snyad do/ /zhes pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa bar 'dod na/ gzugs tshad med kyi rten can gyi nyan thos dgra bcom pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod rang rgyu thub pa'i dbang pos rten 'brel zab mo'i chos bstan pa la nyan sems bsgom gsum byas pa la brten nas 'khrungs pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig de'i thad kyi 'jug 'grel du/ sangs rgyas rnams byung bar gyur pa na rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba phyin ci ma log pa ston pa la 'jug pa'i phyir la/

de nyan pa dang / sems pa dang / bsgom pa'i rim pa las kyang lhag par mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du nyan thos la sogs pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod rten 'brel zab mo'i chos nyid kyis thos pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod nyan thos rgyud la ldan pa'i gang zag du thal lo/ /'dod na/ de chos can/ de ma yin par thal/ chos can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa bar ma khyab na/ bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal dgra bcom pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod rang rgyu thub pa'i dbang pos rten 'brel zab mo'i chos bstan pa la brten nas dngos su 'khrungs pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyed de min par thal/ khyod/ rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams ma byung zhing / /nyan thos rnams kyang zad pa na/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni/ /rten pa med par rab tu 'byung / /zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i rang rgyal yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / nyan thos 'phags pa yin na/ nyan thos kyi sgra bshad 'jug gnyis car yod pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ byang sems 'phags pa yin na/ rgyal sras kyi sgra bshad 'jug gnyis car yod pa'i gang zag yin dgos pa'i phyir ro zer na/ ma khyab/ ma grub na/ der thal/ rtags de yin la/ gsal pa ma yin pa'i gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa bar 'dod na/ gzugs med kyi rten can gyi nyan thos 'phags pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod 'jug 'grel las/ bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi lam/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams las thos nas de don du gnyer ba rnams la sgrogs par byed pas na nyan thos dag ste/ zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i nyan thos su thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/

khyod dam pa'i chos rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams las nyan nas/ de gang zag gzhan la sgrogs pa po'i gang zag tu thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod dam pa'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa po'i gang zag tu thal lo/ /'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod de ma yin par thal/ khyod ngag smra brjod dang bral ba'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can gyis 'grub bo/ /gzhan yang / sangs rgyas 'phags pa de byang chub sems dpa' las 'khrungs par thal/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' las 'khrungs shing / /zhes pa'i gzhung des de ltar bstan pa'i phyir te/ de'i bstan don grub pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod na/ de de min par thal/ byang chub sems dpa' de sangs rgyas 'phags pa las 'khrungs ma thag pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod der thal/ khyod rgyal ba sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sras yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod der thal/ khyod rgyal sras yin pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab bo/ /rtags chos can gyis 'grub/ des na rang lugs byang chub sems dpa' rnams la rgyal sras zhes 'jog pa'i go don ni/ khyod byang chub sems dpa' yin na/ khyod rang rgyur gyur pa'i rgyal ba'i sras yin pas khyab ces pa'i don yin no/ /'dir rgyal sras rgyu gsum gyi lung sbyor cung zad bkod na/ 'jug pa rang 'grel du dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo drangs pa las/ 'od srung 'di lta ste dper na zla ba tshes pa la phyag 'tshal ba ltar nya ba la ni ma yin no/ /'od srung de bzhin du gang dag nga la rab tu dad pa de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag bya'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la ni de ltar ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams las ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung ngo / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams las ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad byung ngo / /zhes dang / dbu ma rin chen phreng ba las/

bdag nyid dang ni 'jig rten 'di/ /bla med byang chub thob 'dod na/ /de yi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /ri dbang rgyal po ltar brtan dang / /phyogs mthas gtugs pa'i snying rje dang / /gnyis la mi brten ye shes lags/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di rnams kyi don 'chad pa la/ bstan bcos 'dir/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams thub pa'i dbang po las 'khrungs/ thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams byang chub sems dpa' las 'khrungs/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams rgyal sras rgyu gsum las 'khrungs zhes bshad pa yin zhing / des na/ dkon brtsegs kyi mdo'i dngos bstan gyi/ zla ba tshes pa lta bu'i rgyal sras dang / 'jug 'grel du/ sman gyi ljon shing gi myu gu'i dpes bstan pa'i rgyal sras dang / 'jug 'grel du/ 'phags pa byams pa'i rnam par thar pa'i mdo'i lung drangs par/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa byang chub tu sems bskyed nas ring por ma lon pa zhes pa'i skabs kyi rgyal sras rnams kyi mas mtha'i sa mtshams yang / byang sems kyi tshogs lam thob ma thag pa nas 'jog dgos pa lung dang rigs pas grub pa yin no/ /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa snying rje gsum gyi dmigs yul gyi khyad par la/ gzhan lugs la dpyad pa dang / rang lugs gzhag pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mkhas pa'i dbang po go bo rab 'byams pas 'jug pa'i dka' 'grel du/ snying rje gsum gyi khyad par dmigs yul gyi sgo nas 'byed de/ de yang / snying rje tshad med gsum gang rung gang zhig sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang 'gyur pa'i khyad par du byas pa'i sems can la dmigs nas/ de dag sdug bsngal las bral 'dod kyi blo de de gsum gyi zlas phye'i sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med kyi mtshan nyid/ de gsum gang rung gang zhig khyab pa 'dul byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi khyad par du byas pa sems can la dmigs nas de dag sdug bsngal las bral 'dod kyi blo de/

de gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med kyi mtshan nyid/ de gsum gang rung gang zhig rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i khyad par du byas pa'i sems can la dmigs nas de dag sdug bsngal las bral 'dod kyi blo de/ de gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de gsum gyi dmigs yul ni/ so so skye bo dang / nyan rang slob pa rnams/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med kyi dmigs yul yin/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med kyi dmigs yul yin/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med kyi dmigs yul du/ so so skye bo/ nyan rang slob mi slob gnyis/ byang sems 'phags pa rjes thob pa rnams 'byung / dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med kyi dmigs yul du/ sems can thams cad 'byung zhes gsung / de dag cung zad mi 'thad de/ 'o na/ las dang po pa'i gang zag gis/ dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med sgom du mi rung bar thal/ byang sems 'phags pa de dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med kyi dmigs yul yin pa gang zhig gang zag las dang po pas byang sems 'phags pa la snying rje bsgom na snying rje go log tu 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong las/ sdig pa byed pa la snying rje mi bsgom par/ chos phyir dka' ba spyod pa la snying rje bsgom na snying rje go log yin no/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ yang byang sems 'phags pa snying rje bsgom pa'i yul du mi rung ba thal/ de 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i sgo nas kyang de sgom pa'i yul du mi rung / de dman pa'i g.yang sar ltung ba'i sgo nas kyang snying rje bsgom pa'i yul du mi rung ba'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ byang sems 'phags pa yin na/ 'khor ba spangs pa'i gang zag yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa grub ste/

de yin na/ dman pa'i g.yang sar mi ltung bas khyab pa yod pa'i phyir te/ de yin na/ rigs kyi stobs kyis phyir mi bzlog pa'i rtags thob pa'i gang zag yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ sbyor lam thob pa'i byang sems yin na/ de ltar yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ rgyan las/ nges 'byed yan lag nas bzung ste/ /mthong dang sgom pa'i lam dag la/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag gnas/ /de 'dir phyir mi zlog pa'i tshogs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang byang 'phags de snying rje sgom pa'i yul du mi rung bar thal/ de 'jig rten lha mir bcas pas bstod bkur bsngags gsum gyi yul yin pa'i phyir te/ spyod 'jug las/ gang la sems kyi dam pa rin chen de/ /skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal nas/ /gang la gnod pa byas kyang bder 'brel ba'i/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes dang / byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i brtson rang gdams pa'i nyams thag rnams/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing / /'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / nyan thos dgra bcom pa de sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med kyi dmigs yul min par thal/ de de'i dmigs yul du mi rung bar khyod rang gis khas blang pa'i phyir te/ nyan rang mi slob pa rnams de'i dmigs yul du mi rung bar khas slang ba'i phyir ro/ /'dod na/ de de'i dmigs yul du rung bar thal/ de dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med du gyur pa'i sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med kyi dmigs yul yin pa'i phyir te/ de dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med kyi dmigs yul yin pa gang zhig de dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med ma yin par gyur pa'i sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med kyi dmigs yul ma yin pa'i phyir/

dang po ma grub na/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa chos can/ der thal/ sems can yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma ma grub na/ dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med min par gyur pa'i sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de med par thal/ dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med yin na/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med yin dgos pa'i phyir/ yang nyan thos dgra bcom pa de sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med kyi dmigs yul yin par thal/ de sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med kyi dmigs yul yin pa'i phyir/ de'i rgyud kyi sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med de nyan thos dgra bcom pa dmigs yul du byed pa'i snying rje yin pa'i phyir te/ de sems can thams cad dmigs yul du byed pa'i rnam mkhyen yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa/ rang lug snying rje gsum gyi dmigs pa ni/ ngan song gsum gyi sems can rnams sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba dang / bde 'gro gsum gyi sems can rnams 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba dang / 'khor ba spyi khyab tu khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba la dmigs nas snying rje gsum po de bsgom par byed pa yin no/ /de yang / rgyal ba byams pa mgon pos/ snying rje bsgom yul de la bcur dbye ba dang / drug tu dbye ba gnyis bshad pa'i dang po ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rab 'bar dgra yi dbang du song / /sdug bsngal gyis non mun pas bsgribs/ /bgrod dka'i lam la rab tu zhugs/ /'ching ba che dang yang dag ldan/ /zas chen dug dang 'dres la zhen/ /lam ni rab tu stong gyur pa/ /lam gol rab bzhugs stobs chung ba'i/ /sems can rnams la snying rje 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'dod chags kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i gang zag dang /

dgra'i nyer 'tshe dang bcas pa'i gang zag dang / sdug bsngal gyis non pa ngan song gi rten can dang / mun pas bsgribs pa las 'bras kyi rnam dbye mi shes pa'i gang zag dang / bgrod dka'i lam la bzhugs pa 'khor ba mtha' med du khyams pa'i gang zag dang / ching ba chen po dang ldan pa mu stegs can rnams dang / zas chen dug dang 'dres pa la zhen pa thos bsam sgom gsum chos brgyad kyis kun nas slangs te byed pa'i gang zag dang / lam rab tu stor ba log sred can gtan yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' ba'i gang zag dang / lam gol ba nyan rang gnyis pa dang / stobs chung ba bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po ma bsags pa'i byang sems las dang po pa ste/ de ltar gang zag bcu po de snying rje'i dmigs yul du gsungs so/ /drug tu dbye ba ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bkren la brtse dang ma rung pa la brtse/ /kun 'khrugs la brtse bag med rnams la brtse/ /yul gyi gzhan dbang can la snying brtse dang / /log par mngon par zhen la snying rje 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sbyin pa'i mi mthun phyogs ser sna'i 'bras bu bkren pa dang ldan pa'i gang zag dang / tshul khrims kyi mi mthun phyogs lus ngag yid gsum ma rungs pa'i gang zag dang / bzod pa'i mi mthun phyogs sems kun tu 'khrugs pa'i gang zag dang / brtson 'grus kyi mi mthun phyogs bag med pa'i gang zag dang / bsam gtan gyi mi mthun phyogs yul gyi gzhan dbang can gyi gang zag dang / shes rab kyi mi mthun phyogs log par mngon par zhen pa shes rab 'chal pa'i gang zag dang drug tu gsung pa yin no/ /des na rang lugs gnad kyi snying po ni/ snying rje tshad med gsum gyi dmigs yul rnams yin khyab mnyam yin/ 'on kyang snying rje tshad med gsum po de don mi gcig ste/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med de yin na/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med yin pas ma khyab/

chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med yin na/ dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med yin na/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med yin pas khyab/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med yin na/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med yin pas khyab zhes khas blangs par bya'o/ /'dir dogs pa cung zad dpyad na/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med yin na/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med yin pas khyab pa yod par thal/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med yin na/ dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med yin pas khyab pa yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med kyi dmigs yul yin na/ dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med kyi dmigs yul yin pas khyab pa yod pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab bo/ /ma grub na/ der thal/ gzhi grub na/ dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med kyi dmigs yul yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa bar 'dod na/ phyi rol pa'i rgyud kyi snying rje tshad med chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags chos can gyis 'grub bo/ /'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod sems can rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi gang zag gam bdag gis stong par rtogs pa'i snying rje yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ phyi rol pa de/ sems can rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi gang zag gi bdag gis stong par rtogs pa'i gang zag yin par thal lo/ /'dod na/ de chos can/ de yang yin par thal/ khyod rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi gang zag gi bdag yod par 'dod pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ phyi rol pa yin pa'i phyir/ de la khyab pa yod de/ za po rtag dngos byed po min pa'i bdag yon tan bya med mu stegs rnams kyis btags/ /de dbye cung zad cung zad la rten nas/ /mu stegs can rnams lugs ni tha dad 'gyur/

/zhes pa'i gzhung gi bstan don grub pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa bar ma khyab na/ sems can rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi gang zag gi bdag gis stong par nges pa'i bye brag tu smra ba'i rgyud kyi snying rje tshad med chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ khyod sems can rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi gang zag gi bdag gis stong par rtogs pa'i snying rje tshad med yin pa'i phyir/ rtags sla/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod sems can thams cad bden med du rtogs pa'i snying rje yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de 'dra'i bye brag tu smra ba de sems can thams cad bden med du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig bzhi brgya pa las/ gcig gi stong nyid gang yin pa/ /de ni kun gyi stong nyid yin/ /gcig gi lta po gang yin pa/ /de ni kun gyi lta po yin/ /zhes pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod de min par thal/ khyod dngos smra ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / snying rje tshad med yin na/ snying rje chen po yin dgos par thal/ snying rje chen po yin na/ snying rje tshad med yin dgos pa'i phyir/ zer na/ mngon pa kun btus las/ snying rje tshad med la bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi snyoms 'jug thob dgos par bshad pa ltar na rtags ma grub zer ro/ /rtsa bar 'dod na/ nyan thos kyi rgyud kyi snying rje tshad med chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags chos can gyis 'grub/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod chen po bdun ldan gyi snying rje yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na sla'o/ /rgyal sras rgyu gsum snying rje tshad med gsum/ /so so'i mtshan nyid dbye ba dmigs yul bcas/ /lung dang rigs pas bla ma'i gsung bzhin du/ /legs par 'chad pa kho bo'i man ngag yin/

༈ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems lta dang po la gnas kyang / /zhes sogs kyis skabs su/ /ngag sbyor dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ byang sems sa dang po des nyan rang dgra bcom bsod nams kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus kyang / blo gros kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon mi nus pa yin te/ byang sems sa dang po des/ theg chen thun mong min pa'i bsod nams kyis nyan rang zil gyis gnon nus kyang / des mtshan 'dzin slar mi skye ba'i chos can du byas pa'i sgo nas mtha' bzhi'i spros bral gyi chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la/ byas sems sa dang po pas nyan rang dgra bcom bsod nams kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus pa'i go don bshad pa dang / nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod med la dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems lta dang po la gnas kyang zhes sogs kyi gzhung 'dis/ byang sems sa dang po pas nyan rang dgra bcom bsod nams kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus pa dngos su bstan la/ de'i go don ni/ byang sems sa dang po pa des byams snying rje kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang / lhag bsam rnams dag gi stobs kyis nyan rang dgra bcom rnams zil gyis gnon nus zhing / der ma zad byang sems kyi tshogs lam thob ma thag pa'i rgyal sras des kyang nyan rang dgra bcom rnams bsod nams kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus pa yin te/ 'jug 'grel du/ 'phags pa byams pa'i rnam par thar pa'i mdo drangs pa las/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na rgyal po'i bu skyes nas ring po ma lon pa rgyal po'i mtshan dang ldan pa ni blon po'i tshogs rgan po gtso bor gyur pa thams cad kyang rigs kyi bdag nyid che ba'i dbang gis zil gyis gnon to/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa byang chub tu sems bskyed nas ring po ma lon pa/

de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi rgyal po'i rigs su skyes pas kyang byang chub kyi sems dang / snying rje'i dbang gis nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas yun ring du tshangs par spyad pa rnams zil gyis gnon to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na nam mkha' lding gi dbang po chen po'i phru gu skyes nas ring po ma lon pa'i gshog pa'i rlung gi shugs dang / mig yongs su dag pa'i yon tan gang yin pa de ni de las gzhan pa'i bya'i tshogs ma lus pa rgas par gyur pa thams cad la yod pa ma yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' byang chub tu sems dang po bskyed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha' lding gi dbang po chen po'i rigs kyi rgyud du yang dag par byung ba nam mkha' lding gi dbang po chen po'i phru gu thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du sems bskyed pa'i gshog pa'i stobs kyis pha rol gnon pa dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa yongs su dag pa'i mig gi yon tan gang yin pa de ni bskal pa brgya stong nges par 'byung ba'i nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad la yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes dpe gnyis kyi sgo nas/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems sogs lhag bsam rnam dag gi sgo nas theg chen gyi gang zag thams cad kyis nyan rang rnams zil gyis gnon nus par gsungs pa yin no/ /des na/ khyod theg chen gyi gang zag yin na/ khyod nyan rang dgra bcom rnams bsod nams kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus pa'i gang zag yin pas khyab/ rtags 'dra ba la/ khyod byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi stobs kyis de ltar nus pa'i gang zag yin pas khyab/ lhag bsam rnam dag gi stobs kyis de ltar nus pa'i gang zag yin pas khyab/ theg chen kun rdzob sems bskyed kyi stobs kyis de ltar nus pa'i gang zag yin pas khyab/ zhes khas blangs par bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa/ nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod med la dpyad pa la/

bshad gzhi'i lung drang ba/ lung gi don rang 'grel la brten nas rgyas par bshad pa/ de dag gi don brda chad kyi snying por bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'jug pa rang 'grel du sa bcu pa'i mdo drang pa las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di lta ste/ dper na rgyal po'i rigs su skyes pa'i rgyal po'i bu rgyal po'i mtshan dang ldan pa ni skyes pa tsam gyis rgyal po'i byin gyis blon po'i tshogs thams cad zil gyis gnon gyi/ rang gi blo'i stobs kyis rnam par dpyad pas ni ma yin no/ /nam de nar son par gyur pa de'i tshe rang gi blo'i stobs bskyed pas blon po'i bya ba thams cad las shin tu 'das pa yin no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang sems bskyed ma thag tu lhag pa'i bsam pa'i che ba nyid kyis nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad zil gyis gnon gyi/ rang gi blo'i stobs kyis rnam par dpyad pas ni ma yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni rang gi yul shes pa'i che ba la gnas pas nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi bya ba thams cad las shin tu 'das pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la/ nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod pa'i dam bca' bzhag pa/ sgrub byed kyi rigs pa gsum bkod pa/ shes byed kyi lung bdun bkod pa/ de dag la rtsod pa spang ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ sa bdun pa thob nas theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i yul shes pa'i che ba la gnas pas/ nyan rang rnams blo gros kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus pa yin gyi/ byang sems sa drug pa ba man chad kyis mtshan 'dzin slar mi skye ba'i chos can du ma byas zhing / mu bzhi'i sprod pa dang bral ba'i chos dbyings mngon sum du ma rtogs pas na nyan rang dgra bcom rnams/ blo gros kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon mi nus so zhes 'chad pa 'di/
