dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i dgongs pa phul du phyin pa yin te/ rang 'grel las/ de'i phyir/ de ltar na ring du song ba kho na nas bzung nas ni byang chub sems pas rang gi blo'i stobs bskyed pas kyang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dag zil gyis gnon par 'gyur gyi/ sa 'og ma rnams su ni ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sgrub byed kyi rigs pa ni/ mdo sde sa bcu pa'i lung 'di'i dngos bstan la/ nyan rang gnyis la chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa'am/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod par bstan pa yin zhing bstan pa ltar du/ nyan rang gnyis kyis chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yang yin te/ de ltar ma yin na/ 'chad par 'gyur ba'i 'gal brjod kyi rigs pa gsum gyis gnod pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang / rang 'grel las/ lung 'di las ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams la yang chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa yang yod do zhes bya bar gsal bar nges te/ zhes gsungs so/ /'o na 'gal brjod kyi rigs pa gsum gang zhe na/ rigs pa dang po ni/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa dang / rang rgyal dgra bcom pa de dag chos can/ khyod kyang don dam pa'i byang chub tu sems dang po bskyed pa'i sa dang po pas kyang blo gros kyi rnam par dpyad pas kyang zil gyis gnon par 'gyur bar thal/ khyod dngos po dang dngos med kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin med par ma shes pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ dper na 'jig rten pa'i chags bral te/ ci yang med kyi nyon mongs dgu pa man chad spangs pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi skyes bu bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i rigs pa la 'jog ste/ rang 'grel las/ de lta ma yin na/ dngos po rang bzhin med par yongs su shes pa dang bral ba'i phyir/ 'jig rten pa'i 'dod chags dang bral ba ltar de dag kyang sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpas kyang rang gi blos rnam par dpyad pas kyang zil gyis gnon par 'gyur la/

zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /thal 'gyur de la 'dod lan 'debs na/ sngar drangs pa'i sa bcu pa'i lung dang 'gal zhes pa ni 'grel bshad kyi dgongs pa yin no/ /rigs pa gnyis pa ni/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa dang / rang rgyal dgra bcom pa 'di dag chos can/ khyod kyis khams gsum gyi sas bsdus pa'i nyon mongs pa phra rgyas thams cad spangs par yang mi 'gyur par thal/ khyod dngos po thams cad rang bzhin med par ma shes pa'i skyes bu yin pa'i phyir/ dper na srid rtse'i dngos gzhi snyoms 'jug thob pa'i phyi rol pa bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i rigs pa la 'jog ste/ rang 'grel las/ phyi rol pa bzhin du 'di dag gis khams gsum na spyod pa'i phra rgyas thams cad spangs par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / de'i thad kyi 'grel bshad las/ des na nyan thos la sogs pa rnams kyis nyon mongs pa spangs par khas len na bdag med pa gnyis yongs su shes pa khas blangs dgos so/ /chos kyi bdag med pa yongs su shes pa med na nyon mongs pa spongs bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rigs pa gsum pa ni/ nyan rang dgra bcom pa rnams chos can/ khyod kyis gang zag gi bdag med kyang rtogs par mi 'gyur bar thal/ khyod kyis las 'bras kyi rten du gyur pa'i bdag gam gang zag tu gdags pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i phung po lnga bden yod yin pa la dmigs pa'i phyir ste/ khyod kyis gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po lnga bden med du ma rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i rigs pa la 'jog te/ rang 'grel/ gzugs la sogs pa'i rang gi ngo bo la dmigs pas phyin ci log tu gyur pa'i phyir/ gang zag gi bdag med pa rtogs pa yang mi 'gyur te/ bdag tu gdags pa'i rgyu phung po la dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / de'i thad kyi 'grel bshad las/ gal te nyan thos la sogs pa rnams la gang zag gi bdag med pa yongs su shes pa yod par khas len na ni de'i tshe phung po rang bzhin med pa nyid du shes pa med na de 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/

/des na chos kyi bdag med pa yongs su shes pa nyid du 'grub pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bdag tu gdags pa'i rgyu phung po la dmigs pa zhes pa'i don ni/ rang rgyud kyi phung po lnga la dmigs pa sngon du song ba la brten nas/ gzhi med la nga'o snyam du bden par 'dzin pa ni gang zag gi bdag 'dzin lhan skyes yin la/ de'i dmigs yul du gyur pa'i phung po lnga bden med du ma rtogs na/ phung po lnga yang bden med du rtogs par mi 'gyur zhing / de ma rtogs na gang zag gi bdag med kyang rtogs par mi 'gyur zhes pa'i don yin te/ 'grel bshad las/ phung po la mngon par zhen pa sngon du 'gro ba can bdag tu mngon par zhen pa'i bag chags kyis 'jug pa yin no/ /des na ji srid du phung po la mngon par zhen pa yod pa de srid du bdag la mngon par zhen pa'i bag chags mi ldog pas gang zag gi bdag med pa yongs su shes par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ 'dir 'phros pa'i rigs pa ni/ nyan rang dgra bcom pas ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyi yul du gyur pa'i phung po lnga bden med du rtogs kyang / spyir phung po lnga bden med du ma rtogs so snyam na/ 'o na/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud la gzugs sogs phung po lnga la dmigs nas chags sogs nyon mongs pa skye bar 'gyur bar thal/ khyod gzugs sogs phung po lnga bden med du ma rtogs zhing / de dag bden yod la dmigs pa'i blo rgyud ldan gyi skyes bu yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i rigs pa lta bu la 'jug ste/ bstan bcos 'di nyed las/ khyod kyis rnal 'byor bdag med mthong pa yis/ /gzugs sogs de nyid rtogs par mi 'gyur zhing / /gzugs la dmigs nas 'jug phyir 'dod chags sogs/ /skye 'gyur de yi ngo bo rtogs med phyir/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i dgongs pas/

dngos smra ba gsum dang dbu ma rang rgyud pa man chad kyis gang zag gi bdag med rtogs tshul tsam gyis gang zag gi bdag med mtshan nyid pa rtogs par mi 'gyur zhes khas len dgos pas/ dngos smra ba gsum po gang rung yin na/ gang zag gi bdag med ma rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pas khyab zhes khas blang bar bya'o/ /gsum pa lung bdun gyi/ lung dang po ni/ sngar drangs pa'i mdo sde sa bcu pa'i lung de nyid do/ /lung gnyis pa ni/ rin po che'i phreng ba las/ ji srid phung por 'dzin yod pa/ /zhes sogs tshig bcad gsum drangs pa de yin no/ /lung gsum pa ni/ rin chen phreng ba las/ ji ltar mig ni 'khrul pa la/ /zhes pa nas/ byang chub bar du srid mtshams sbyor/ /zhes pa'i bar tshigs bcad bcu drangs pa de'o/ /lung bzhi pa ni/ nyan thos kyi sde snod las/ gzugs ni dbu ba brdos pa 'dra/ /tshor ba chu yi chu bur bzhin/ /zhes sogs tshigs rkang bdun drangs pa de yin no/ /lung lnga pa ni/ theg pa che las skye med bstan/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig drangs pa de'o/ /lung drug pa ni/ bcom ldan dngos dang dngos med pa/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig drangs pa de'o/ /lung bdun pa ni/ mtshan la med par ma rtogs par/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig drangs pa de yin no/ de ltar lung bdun po de rnams kyis kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa med na/ thar pa thob pa med par bstan pa'i sgo nas/ nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod par bsgrub pa ni/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa rtsod pa spang pa la/ rtsod pa dang / lan gnyis/ dang po la/ gang la/ gang gis/ ji ltar rtsod pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gong du nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod pa'i shes byed du/ theg dman gyi sde snod las kyang chos kyi bdag med bstan tshul bkod pa de la rtsod/ gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon legs ldan byed sogs rang rgyud pa rnams kyis rtsod pa yin te/

dbu ma tshigs gsal las/ shin du gsal bar bshad do/ /gsum pa ji ltar rtsod pa'i tshul ni/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa na re/ theg dman gyi sde snod las logs su theg chen gyi sde snod bstan pa la dgos pa med par thal/ theg dman gyi sde snod las chos kyi bdag med bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis rtsod pa yin te/ rang 'grel las/ gang zhig gal te nyan thos kyi theg pa las kyang chos la bdag med pa bstan na de'i tshe theg chen bstan pa don med par 'gyur ro snyam du sems pa de'i lung de yang 'di ltar rigs pa dang lung dang 'gal bar rtogs so/ /zhes dang / de'i thad kyi 'grel bshad las kyang / de ltar nyan thos la sogs pa la chos kyi bdag med pa yongs su shes yod pa nyid yin no zhes rab tu bsgrubs nas/ gzhan gyi dogs po gsu bar bya ba'i phyir/ gang zhig gal te zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa lan 'chad pa la/ chos kyi bdag med tsam bstan pa'i phyir du theg chen gyi sde snod bstan pa ma yin pa'i tshul bshad pa dang / chos kyi bdag med gsal rgyas tshang gsum gyi sgo nas ston pa'i phyir du theg chen gyi sde snod bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang rgyud pa'i rtsod pa de la khyab pa yod pa ma yin te/ theg chen gyi sde snod des ni chos bdag med tsam 'ba' zhig ston par byed pa ma yin gyi/ theg chen gyi sde snod des ni byang chub sems dpa'i lam lnga sa bcu dang / lam pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang / smod lam rgya chen po dang / snying rje tshad chen po dang / theg pa chen po'i yongs su bsngo ba dang / tshogs gnyis rgya chen po dang / theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos nyid la sogs pa theg pa chen po'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum thams cad rgya cher bstan pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang rang 'grel las/ theg pa chen po bstan pas ni chos la bdag med pa tsam 'bab zhig ston par byed pa ma yin gyi/

'o na ci zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi/ sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa dang / smon lam dang snying rje chen po la sogs pa dang yongs su bsngo ba dang tshogs gnyis dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos nyid kyang yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di'i lung sbyor du/ rin po che'i phreng ba las/ nyan thos theg pa de las ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang / /spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad des/ /byang chub sems dpar ga la 'gyur/ /byang chub spyod la gnas pa'i don/ /mdo sde las ni bka' ma stsal/ /theg pa che las bka' stsal pa/ /de phyir mkhas pa rnams kyis bzung / /zhes pa 'di 'dren par mdzad cing don ni sngar bshad pa bzhin yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ chos kyi bdag med gsal rgyas tshang gsum bstan pa'i phyir du theg dman gyi sde snod las logs su theg chen gyi sde snod gsungs pa yin te/ theg chen gyi sde snod las ni chos kyi bdag med gsal bar bshad/ rgyas par bshad/ tshang bar bshad pa yin la/ nyan thos kyi sde snod las ni chos kyi bdag med mdor bsdus pa tsam zhig bstan pa yin gyi/ rgyas par ma bstan pa'i phyir te/ dper na sher phyin gyi mdo las/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos thams cad bden stong sprod bral du yang yang gtan la phab cing / 'dul ba lung gi nang tshan/ 'phags pa ka ta ya na la gdams pa'i gdams ngag las/ stong nyid mdor bsdus pa tsam zhig bstan pa de de dag gi mtshan gzhi rim bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang rang 'grel las/ chos kyi bdag med pa gsal bar bya ba'i phyir theg pa chen po bstan pa yang rigs pa nyid de/ rgyas par bstan par brjod par 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /nyan thos kyi theg pa las ni chos kyi bdag med pa mdor mtshon pa tsam zhig tu zad do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di'i lung sbyor du sngar drangs pa'i lung bdun pa/ mtshan ma med pa ma rtogs par/ /khyod kyi thar pa med par gsungs/

/de phyir khyod kyis theg chen las/ /de ni tshang bar bstan pa lags/ /zhes pa 'di 'dren par mdzad pa yin no/ /'dir skabs kyi mtshan ma med pa ma rtogs par zhes pa'i mtshan bral gyi dbyings de gong du bshad pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos nyid zhes pa de dang gnad gcig cing / de yang theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i yul mu bzhi'i spros pa dang bral ba'i chos dbyings de la 'jog pa yin no/ /'o na 'phags pa ka ta ya na la gdams pa'i mdo las stong nyid mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis bstan tshul ji ltar snyam na/ 'dul lung gi nang tshan ka ta ya na'i gdams ngag las/ ka ta ya na gang gi phyir 'jig rten 'di phal cher yod pa nyid dang / med pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa des/ skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid bde ba'i sgo nas yongs su grol bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i sgo nas stong nyid mdor bsdus pa tsam zhig bshad cing / 'di nyid khungs su mdzad nas rtsa ba shes rab tu yang / bcom ldan dngos dang dngos med pa/ /mkhyen pas ka ta ya na yi/ /gdams ngag las ni yod pa dang / /med pa gnyis ka dgag pa mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa de dag gi don brda dpyad kyi snying por 'dral nas bshad pa ni/ spyir dbu ma thal rang gnyis nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa med pa dang yod pa'i sgo nas khyad par 'byed pa yin te/ rang rgyud pas nyan rang la chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pa med par 'dod/ thal 'gyur bas nyan rang la chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pa yod par 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i gzhung lugs gtsang ma rnams las nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa med pa mtha' cig tu bshad cing / rang rgyud pa'i gzhung cha mthun pa bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan las kyang /

theg chen tshogs lam 'chad pa'i skabs su/ mtshan med rab tu sbyin la sogs/ /yang dag bsgrub la mkhas pa ni/ /rnam pa thams cad rtogs 'di la/ /thar pa'i cha dang mthun par 'dod/ /ces theg chen tshogs lam de mtshan med kyi dbyings rtogs pa'i sgo nas theg dman tshogs lam las khyad par du 'phags par bshad/ theg chen sbyor lam gyi skabs su/ dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa/ /bden pa'i rten can de yis ni/ /rnam pa mngon zhen la sogs 'gog /theg pa gsum car thob pa'i rgyu/ /zhes theg chen sbyor lam de chos thams cad bden stong du rtogs pa'i rnam pa can yin pa'i sgo nas/ theg dman sbyor lam las khyad par du 'phags par bshad/ theg chen mthong lam 'chad pa'i skabs su/ bsam mi khyab sogs khyad par gyi/ /khyad zhugs bden pa'i spyod yul can/ /skad cig ma ni bcu drug gi /khyad par mtshan nyid bshad pa yin/ /zhes theg chen mthong lam de bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas/ theg chen mthong lam las khyad par du 'phags par bshad/ theg chen sgom lam 'chad pa'i skabs su/ sgom pa'i lam ni zab pa ste/ /zab mo stong pa nyid la sogs/ /zab pa de ni sgro 'dogs dang / /bskur ba'i mtha' ni grol bar 'dod/ /zhes theg chen sgom lam de sgro bskur gyi mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas/ theg dman sgom lam las khyad par du 'phags par bshad/ theg chen gzhi shes spyi tsam 'chad pa'i tshe yang / tshu rol pha rol mtha' la min/ /de dag bar na mi gnas pa/ /dus rnams mnyam pa nyid shes phyir/ /shes rab pha rol phyin par 'dod/ /zhes theg chen gzhi shes de/ /srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas/ theg dman gzhi shes las khyad par du 'phags par bshad/ mi slob lam gyi skabs su/ mdo sde rgyan las/ ji ltar mdud pa'i bye brag gis/ /gos la mtshon bkra mi bkra ba/

/de bzhin 'phen pa'i dbang gis ni/ /grol ba'i ye shes bkra mi bkra/ /zhes theg chen mi slob lam de chos kyi gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pas na/ shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa thams cad la mkhyen pa rnam par bkra zhing / theg dman gyi mi slob lam gnyis kyi chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mngon sum du ma rtogs pas/ shes bya thams cad la mkhyen pa rnam par mi bkra ba de byung zhes gsal bar bshad do/ /gzhung 'di dag dang mthun par slob dpon legs ldan byed kyang nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa med par kho nar bzhed cing / bzhed srol de 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa ma yin pa'i tshul ni/ dbu ma 'jug pa 'dir/ de ni ring du song bar blo yang lhag par 'gyur/ /zhes pa rtsa 'grel gyi skabs su/ shin tu gsal bar bshad pa yin te/ dbu ma tshig gsal las/ slob dpon 'di ji ltar rnam pa de lta bu'i yul la slob dpon gyi lugs kyi rjes su 'jug pa ma yin pa de lta bu ni dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ ring du song bar blo yang lhag par 'gyur zhes bya ba der bstan zin pas/ yang de sun dbyung ba la 'bad par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di la mkhas pa rnam dpyod yod pa zhig gis bltas na smyon med du grub pa'i phyir ro/ /'grel pa 'di'i skabs kyi slob dpon zhes pa snga ma de slob dpon legs ldan byed la ngos 'dzin/ slob dpon zhes pa phyi ma de 'phags klu sgrub la ngos 'dzin pa yin zhing / ring du song bar blo yang lhag par 'gyur zhes bya bar bstan zin zhes pas ni/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pas 'grel pa tshigs gsal brtsom pa'i snga rol du 'jug pa rtsa 'grel gnyis mdzad zin par yang dngos su bstan pa yin no/ /dbu ma rang rgyud pas nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa med par 'dod pa'i rnam gzhag rgyas par shes par 'dod na rang rgyud kyi gzhung rgyan snang bden gsum dang /

slob dpon seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa'i 'grel ba don gsal/ brgyad stong 'grel chen sogs las rtogs par bya'o/ /'di dag gi don bsdus ni/ bstan bcos chen po dpal gyi 'khri shing du yang / dbu ma'i rgya mtshor zhugs nas theg gsum la/ /lta ba'i rim pa rnyed 'di ma pham pa'i/ /gzhung nas brkus sam klu sgrub gzhung lugs na/ /gtam 'di byis pa'i sgra snyan tsam du rtsi/ /klu sgrub gzhung gi mdza' bor yid gcugs la/ /byams pa'i de nyid mgron du 'bod pa mtshar/ /thun mong ma yin gsung bas 'khon gcugs tshe/ /chos srid dbu rmog btsan po'ang de nas 'jig /ces byams pa dang klu sgrub kyi gzhung lugs nas bshad pa'i theg gsum gyi lta rim gcig tu bsres na gzhung lugs de dag gi gnad bcos pa yin par gsungs so/ /yang dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi gsung gi snying po dpal ldan zla ba grags pas legs par bkral ba'i srol dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs la/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can zhig rgyud la ma skyes na lam mtshan nyid pa rgyud la skyes par mi 'gyur bas/ theg pa gsum po gang yin yang tshogs lam thob pa nas bzung ste nges par gnas lugs kyi don rtogs pa zhig dgos shing / theg pa gsum po gang rung gi 'phags pa yin na/ chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pas khyab pa ni/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi gzhung lugs rnams dang / 'jug pa rtsa 'grel/ 'grel pa tshig gsal sogs kyi dgongs pa phul du phyin pa yin no/ /'di dag dang mthun par rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas/ thub pa dgongs gsal las kyang shin tu gsal bar gsung pa yin te/ sbyor lam 'chad pa'i skabs su/ de nyid las/ 'phags pa klu sgrub mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi dgongs pas theg pa gsum ka'i sbyor lam la thabs kyi khyad par dang / nges 'byed bzhi'i rang rang gi dmigs pa gsal mi gsal gyi khyad par ma gtogs pa bdag med rtogs pa la khyad par mi bzhed de/

nyan thos kyi sa la slob par 'dod pas kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la bslab par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa dang / gang dag bde gshegs nyan thos 'gyur bar bya snyam dang / /rang sangs rgyas dang de bzhin chos rgyal 'gyur 'dod pa/ /bzod pa 'di la ma brten thob par mi nus te/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bzhed do/ /zhes dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par 'grel ba'i tshe/ theg chen sbyor lam dang theg dman sbyor lam la thabs snying rje chen pos zin ma zin gyi khyad par dang / theg pa gsum po rang rang gi sbyor lam drod rtse bzod pa chos mchog bzhis/ rang rang gi dmigs rnam gsal mi gsal gyi khyad par ma gtogs pa/ chos thams cad bdag med dam bden med du rtogs pa la khyad par ci yang med cing / de ltar bzhed pa de sher phyin gyi mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ nyan thos kyi sa la slob par 'dod pas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la bslab par bya'o zhes sogs dang / mdo bsdud pa las/ gang dag bde gshegs nyan thos 'gyur bar bya snyam dang / /rang sangs rgyas dang de bzhin chos rgyal 'gyur 'dod pa/ /bzod pa 'di la ma brten thob par mi nus te/ /dper na tshu rol pha rol 'gro ngogs mi mthong bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa bla na med pa yin par bzhed do zhes pa'o/ /'dir skabs kyi bzod pa zhes pa yang chos thams cad bdag med pa'i don la mi skrag pa'i bzod pa zhes bya ba chos thams cad bden stong spros bral du rtogs pa'i dbu ma'i lta ba la 'jog cing / lta ba de la ma brten par nyan thos rang rgyal theg chen gyi lam gang du yang 'jug par mi nus zhes pa'i don yin no/ /yang thub pa dgongs gsal las/ theg pa chen po thun mong ma yin pa 'ga' zhig ni/ yum las/ nyan thos kyi sa la slob par 'dod pas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la bslab par bya'o/

/zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ slob dpon 'phags pa yab sras ni rigs can gsum kas bdag med rtogs pa la khyad par mi bzhed do/ /zhes dang / mthong lam dang sgom lam gnyis 'chad pa'i skabs su/ de nyid las/ theg pa chen po thun mong ma yin pa ni mthong lam du rtogs pa'i chos nyid dang ye shes chos can mtha' dag dang / 'brel ba goms par bsgom pa'o/ /zhes 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras zla ba grags pa dang bcas pa'i bzhed pa la theg gsum gyi lam rnams dbu ma'i lta ba la blo gros na mnyam pa 'di kho na bzhed pa yin no zhes chos kyi rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs de nyid kyi thugs rab kyi rtsal ston nas phyin ci ma log par bshad pa yin no/ /gnad 'di dag ma mthong bar deng sang sa skya par grags pa 'ga' zhig nyan rang la stong nyid rtogs pa yod par 'dod pa de spyir 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi bzhed pa min zhing khyad par rje btsun gong ma'i bzhed pa ma yin zhes smra ba rnams ni/ spyir dbu ma'i gzhung lugs la sbyangs pa cher ma mdzad pa dang / khyad par du rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab kyi gnad kyi snying po ma longs pa'i skyon du shes par gyis shig gzhan yang thub pa dgongs gsal dang mthun par/ gzhung lugs legs bshad las kyang / de yang gzhung lugs kha cig gi dbang du byas nas gang zag gi bdag med rtogs shing / chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs so zhes rnam par gzhag pa yin gyi don gyi gnas lugs la nyan rang gis bdag med gnyis ka rtogs pa yin ste/ zhes dang / gal te nyan rang gis chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs na/ nyan thos dgra bcom dang rang rgyal chos can/ khams gsum du skye ba len par thal te/ dngos po 'am phung por 'dzin pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la gsum las/ rtags ma grub bo zhe na/ chos la bdag 'dzin yod pa nyams so/ khyab pa ma grub bo zhe na/ /slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ ji srid phung por 'dzin yod pa/

/de srid de la ngar 'dzin yod/ /ngar 'dzin yod na yang las te/ /de las yang ni skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes bshad pa las grub bo/ /'dod na/ nyan thos dgra bcom dang rang rgyal chos can/ mya ngan las 'das nas 'khor ba la mi gnas pa'i skye ba len pa ma yin par 'gyur te/ khams gsum gyi skye ba len pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod na/ dpal phreng gi mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das dper na len pa'i rkyen gyis zag pa dang bcas pa'i las kyi rgyu las byung ba'i srid pa gsum 'byung ba de bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'das ma rig pa'i bag chags kyi sa'i rkyen gyis zag pa med pa'i las kyi rgyu las byung pa dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang dbang thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus gsum 'byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das ma rig pa'i bag chags kyi sa gsum po 'di dag tu/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyis lus gsum po 'di dag 'byung ba dang / zag pa med pa'i las mngon par grub pa'i rkyen lags so zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal lo/ /zhes sogs bshad pa ltar/ nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa med na/ 'jug pa rang 'grel las bshad pa'i 'gal ba brjod pa'i thal 'gyur gsum gyis gnod tshul dang / rigs pa de dag gi kha bskong dang lung sbyor sogs dpyis phyin pa bshad nas nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod par sgrub par mdzad do/ /'di dag dang mthun par rigs gter rang 'grel las kyang / theg pa gsum gyi bdag med rtogs tshul bshad pa'i 'phros las/ nyan thos dang theg pa chen po 'ga' zhig 'phags pa gsum la bdag med rtogs pa'i khyad par mi 'dod de/ bden pa bzhi'i chos nyid dam chos thams cad bdag med par ma rtogs na bden pa mthong ba mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang mchog dman gyi khyad par ni snying rje dang thabs kyi bye brag la ltos par 'dod do/ /zhes nyan thos sde gnyis theg pa gsum la lta ba mtho dman gyi rim pa mi 'dod pa dang /

theg pa chen po dbu ma thal 'gyur pa yang theg pa gsum gyi lam la lta ba mtho dman gyi khyad par mi bzhed do zhes shin tu gsal bar bshad pa yin no/ /de bzhin du rje btsun rtse mos rgyud sde spyi rnam las kyang / slob dpon zla ba grags pa la sogs pa ni lam gcig las 'bras bu gsum du bzhed do zhes gsungs shing de'i don ni/ theg pa gsum gyi lam thams cad chos kyi bdag med dam stong nyid rtogs pa'i lam du mtshungs zhing / de lta bu'i chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i lam de las theg pa gsum gyi 'bras bu gsum zhes pa theg gsum gyi theg pa thun mong zhes pa'i don du snang ngo / /des na deng sang 'ga' zhig dag dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i gzhung lugs 'chad bzhin du/ nyan rang la stong nyid rtogs pa med do zhes smra ba dang / nyan rang la stong nyid rtogs pa yod par 'dod pa la mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel dang / rgyud bla rtsa 'grel dang 'gal ba'i lung rigs mang du 'phen par byed pa dag ni gzhung lugs chen po rnams kyi gnad ma 'dres par so sor 'byed ma shes pa'i rnam 'gyur du shes par gyis shig gnad des na rang lugs gnad kyi snying po ni/ nyan rang gnyis la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod kyang / de dag la chos kyi bdag med pa rdzogs par bsgom pa ni med de/ de dag gis nyon sgrib spong ba'i phyir de ltar bsgom pa tsam yin gyis/ shes sgrib spong ba'i phyir du de ltar bsgom pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang de dag la gang zag gi bdag med ni rdzogs par bsgom pa yod do/ /de ltar yang 'thad de/ rang 'grel las/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba rkyen nyid 'di pa tsam mthong mod kyi/ de ltar na yang de dag la chos kyi bdag med pa yongs su rdzogs par sgom pa med de/ khams gsum na spyod pa'i nyon mongs pa spong ba'i thabs tsam zhig ni yod do/

/de dag la gang zag gi bdag med pa ma lus par bsgom pa ni yod par rnam par gzhag go /zhes dang / de'i 'grel bshad las/ chos kyi bdag med pa yongs su rdzogs par bsgom pa med do/ /zhes bya ba ni/ mtshan ma med cing rtsol ba med pa'i mtshan nyid can/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams thob pa'i rten tu gyur pa de/ de rnams la yod pa ma yin pas so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na nyan rang gnyis kyis chos kyi bdag med rgyas par rtogs pa yod do/ chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pa yod pa'i phyir/ yang de dag la chos kyi bdag med gsal bar rtogs pa yod de/ de dag la chos kyi bdag med gsal snang thob pa'i tshul gyis rtogs pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /yang de dag la chos kyi bdag med tshang bar rtogs pa yang yod de/ de dag gi chos kyi bdag med tshang la ma nor bar rtogs pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin na/ chos kyi bdag med rgyas par rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pas khyab/ chos thams cad bden med du bsgom pa'i gang zag yin na/ chos kyi bdag med rgyas par bsgom pa'i gang zag yin pas ma khyab ste/ chos kyi bdag med rdzogs par bsgom pa'i go don ni/ sgrib pa gnyis char spong ba'i phyir du chos kyi bdag med bsgom pa la chos kyi bdag med rdzogs par bsgom par 'jog go zhes dpal ldan zla ba grags pa rang nyid kyis gsal bar gsung 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rang 'grel las/ chos kyi bdag med pa gsal bar bya ba'i phyir theg chen bstan pa yang rigs pa nyid de zhes sogs kyi rtsod lan gsungs pa 'di yang theg chen gyi sde snod las chos kyi bdag med gsal rgyas tshang gsum gyi sgo nas bstan/ theg dman gyi sde snod las chos kyi bdag med mdor bsdus pa tsam zhig bstan zhes pa'i don du 'chad dgos kyi/ gzhan dag gi 'dod pa ltar gzhung de'i don theg dman 'phags pas chos kyi bdag med gsal rgyas tshang gsum gyi sgo nas ma rtogs/

theg chen 'phags pas chos kyi bdag med gsal rgyas tshang gsum gyi sgo nas rtogs zhes pa'i don du sbyar nas 'chad pa la ni 'brel cher mi snang ste 'dir skabs kyi rtsod pa rtsod lan dang / gzhung gi dngos thob shugs thob gang la yang de ltar 'chad dgos pa'i shes byed ci yang mi 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar sngar bshad pa'i 'jug pa rtsa 'grel de dag gi gnad kyi snying po bsdus nas bstan bcos chen po dpal gyi 'khri shing las/ chos kyi bdag med rgyas bsdus blta ba'i gnad/ /theg gnyis 'phags par sbyar nas sgrub byed kyi/ /ngal ba 'bras med rngul gyi thigs pa yis/ gangs can 'di na hrul po'i khyim bzhin snang / /sde snod dag las bstan tshul rgyas dang bsdus/ /sher phyin mdo dang ka ta'i gdams ngag bzhin/ /'phags pa gnyis la bsgom tshul rgyas bsdus tsam/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi bstod par yang / rtogs bya'i chos dang sgrub byed rgyas bsdus las/ /theg gnyis 'phags par rtogs tshul mi 'dra ba'i/ /ri bong bcal sgras ri dwags nags nas stong / /klu sgrub gdong lnga ldan khyod sa steng rgyal/ /dman 'phags rang don nyon mongs spong la 'dun/ /mtha' bral rdzogs par mi bsgom gzhan dag gis/ /ri bong bcal smras bil ba'i shing la bris/ /klu sgrub bstan pa'i srog shing rgyal gyur cig /ces gsal bar gsungs pa 'di dag gi don blo gsal rnams kyis shin tu nges par bya dgos so/ /'o na nyan rang dgra bcom blo gros kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus pa'i rgyal sras kyi sa mtshams gang nas 'jog snyam na/ de'i sa mtshams ni sa bdun pa ring du song ba thob pa nas 'jog pa yin te/ sa bdun pa thob pa'i byang 'phags de mtshan 'dzin slar mi skye ba'i chos can du byas pa'i sgo nas theg chen thun mong min pa'i yul mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rgyal sras yin pa'i phyir ro/

/sa drug pa man chad du ni de lta bu'i nus pa ma thob pas nyan rang rnams blo gros kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon mi nus par 'jog pa yin no/ /rang 'grel las/ ring du song ba kho na nas bzung nas ni byang chub sems dpas rang gi blo'i stobs bskyed pas kyang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dag zil gyi gnon par 'gyur gyis/ zhes nges bzung gi tshig sbyar nas gsal bar gsungs 'dug pa'i phyir/ des na sa bdun pa'i rnam 'grol lam skad cig ma dang po yan chad du mtshan 'dzin slar mi skye ba'i chos can du byas pa'i nus pa che cher thob pa'i stobs kyis 'gog pa yang dag pa'i mtha' la bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma re re la snyoms par 'jug cing ldang bar nus pa yin te/ bstan bcos 'di nyid las/ ring du song ba 'dir ni skad cig dang / /skad cig la ni 'gog par 'jug 'gyur zhing / /zhes dang / de'i rang 'grel la/ 'gog pa la snyom par 'jug pa ni yang dag pa'i mtha' la snyoms par 'jug pa yin pas de bzhin nyid la 'gog pa zhes brjod de/ 'dir spros pa thams cad 'gag par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /sa bdun pa ring du song ba'i 'dir ni sa drug par thob pa'i 'gog pa de la byang chub sems dpa' skad cig dang skad cig la snyoms par 'jug par 'gyur te/ zhes dang / rang 'grel du sa bcu pa'i mdo drangs pa las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag byang chub sems dpa'i sa drug pa yan chad byang chub sems dpa' 'gog pa la snyoms par 'jug ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni sems kyi skad cig dang sems kyi skad cig la yang 'gog pa la snyoms par 'jug cing ldang ste/ 'gog pa mngon sum du byas zhes ni mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir 'gog pa mngon sum du byas zhes ni mi bya'o zhes pa'i don ni/ sa bdun pa'i rnam grol lam yan chad la gnas pa'i sa bdun pa ba des mtshan 'dzin gyi spros pa dang bral ba'i chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs kyang /

blo bur dri bral gyi chos nyid mngon sum du ma rtogs zhes pa'i don yin te/ dper na sher phyin gyi mdo las/ smon lam yongs su rdzogs par ma byas pa dang / sems can yongs su smin par ma byas pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su ma sbyangs par de dag gis yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon sum du ni mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i skabs kyi yang dag pa'i mtha' 'di yang / dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos nyid la nyid ngos 'dzin par sngon gyi mkhas pa tshad ldan du ma bzhed pa dang don mthun pa yin no/ /de dag gi skabs su dogs pa dpyad pa la/ rang lugs la dogs pa dpyad pa dang / gzhan lugs la dogs pa dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ byang sems sa dang po pa des nyan rang dgra bcom bsod nams kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus par thal/ des nyan rang dgra bcom bsod nams kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus la/ blo gros kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon mi nus pa'i khyad par 'thad pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems lta dang po la gnas zhes sogs kyi gzhung don grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gong du 'dod na/ byang sems sa dang po pa des kun rdzob sems bskyed kyi stobs kyis nyan rang dgra bcom rnams zil gyis gnon nus par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig des lhag bsam rnam dag gi stobs kyis nyan rang zil gyis gnon mi nus pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byang sems mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod pa des kun rdzob sems bskyed kyi stobs kyis nyan rang dgra bcom rnams zil gyis gnon nus par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byang sems mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod pa de kho rang gi rgyud kyi kun rdzob sems bskyed kyi stobs kyis de nyid zil gyi gnon nus par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig des thob pa'i kun rdzob sems bskyed kyi stobs kyis nyan rang dgra bcom gnyis zil gyis gnon mi nus pa'i phyir zer na/

rang lugs rtags phyi ma ma grub bo/ /'dod na/ byang sems mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod pa'i rgyud kyi kun rdzob sems bskyed yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud kyi kun rdzob sems bskyed med par thal/ khyod 'phags lam mnyam gzhag ye shes rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag bzhin pa'i gang zag yin pa gang zhig khyod yin na/ 'phags lam mnyam gzhag ye shes la rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag bzhin pa'i gang zag yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /yang / byang sems mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod pa chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud kyi kun rdzob sems bskyed med par thal/ khyod kyi rgyud kyi sems bskyed yin na/ don dam sems bskyed yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ khyod chos can dang cig yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags gnyis pa ma grub na/ des thob pa'i kun rdzob sems bskyed yin na/ nyan rang dgra bcom zil gyis gnon nus pa'i blo yin dgos par thal lo zer na/ ma khyab/ 'dod na/ des thob pa'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i kun rdzob sems bskyed chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de der thal/ de yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod kyis thob pa'i de yod par thal/ khyod stong nyid rtogs pa'i kun rdzob sems bskyed thob pa'i rgyal sras yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod byang 'phags yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gong du 'dod na/ des thob pa'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i blos nyan rang dgra bcom gnyis zil gyis gnon nus par thal lo/ /'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi nyan rang dgra bcom blo gros kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus par thal/ khyod kyis khyod rang gis thob pa'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i blos nyan rang dgra bcom zil gyis gnon nus pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags gsal dngos 'gal/ gong du rtsa ba'i rtags gnyis pa ma grub na/ 'o na byang sems mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod kyis thob pa'i lhag bsam rnam dag yin na/

nyan rang dgra bcom zil gyis gnon nus pa'i blo yin dgos par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ 'dod na/ des thob pa'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i lhag bsam rnam dag chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ bsgrub tshul gong bzhin/ des na 'dir rang lugs gnad kyi snying po ni/ kun rdzob sems bskyed dang don dam sems bskyed gang rung du gyur pa'i gnyis med kyi blo gros med de/ sems bskyed de gnyis gang rung yin na/ gtso bo sems yin pas khyab/ gnyis med kyi blo gros yin na/ sems byung shes rab yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ gnyis med kyi blo gros yin na/ dbu ma'i lta ba yin pas so/ /dbu ma'i lta ba yin na/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kho na yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /yang rang lugs kyi thal 'phreng 'ga' zhig na/ theg chen gyi lam yin na/ dbu ma'i lta ba yin pas khyab zhes bshad pa'ang yod de/ de ltar khas len na/ de dang mthun pa'i skyongs lugs shes dgos so/ /des na byang sems sa dang po pa des kun rdzob sems bskyed kyi stobs kyis nyan rang dgra bcom zil gyis gnon nus te/ de'i rgyud kyi kun rdzob sems bskyed de thabs shes gnyis kyi nang nas thabs bsod nams kyi tshogs gtso bor gyur pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ de'i rgyud kyi don dam sems bskyed kyis nyan rang dgra bcom zil gyis gnon mi nus te/ de'i rgyud kyi don dam sems bskyed de thabs shes gnyis kyi nang nas shes rab khyad par can dang mtshungs ldan du byung ba gtso bor gyur pa'i ye shes kyi tshogs su e pa'i phyir/ des na byang sems mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod pa'i rgyud kyi theg chen gyi lam des nyan rang dgra bcom zil gyi gnon nus sam mi nus snyam na/ de mi nus te/ de'i rgyud kyi theg chen gyi lam de de'i rgyud kyi don dam sems bskyed du e pa'i phyir ro/ /'di dag la rigs pa'i skyong tshul khas blangs shin tu byang ba gcig shes dgos so/

/yang kho na re/ byang sems mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod pa chos can/ khyod nyan thos dgra bcom blo gros kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus pa'i gang zag tu thal/ khyod nyan thos dgra bcom zil gyis gnon nus pa'i blo gros rgyud la ldan pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ khyod gang zag gang zhig khyod kyi rgyud la ldan pa yang yin/ nyan thos dgra bcom zil gyis gnon nus pa'i blo gros kyang yin pa'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ma grub na/ der thal/ byang sems mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod pa'i rgyud kyi don dam sems bskyed dang mtshungs ldan du byung ba'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab de de yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ de'i rgyud la ldan pa gang zhig phyi ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ dang po sla/ gnyis pa ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod der thal/ khyod kyi nyan thos dgra bcom zil gyis gnon nus pa gang zhig khyod blo gros yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma der thal/ dbu ma'i lta bar gyur pa'i shes rab yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dang po ma grub na/ der thal/ de'i rgyud kyi don dam sems bskyed de nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi lam las ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod der thal/ khyod thabs snying rje chen pos zin pa'i lam yin pa gang zhig gcig shos de thabs snying rje chen pos ma zin pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir ro/ yang / byang sems sa dang po'i rgyud kyi gnyis med kyi blo gros des nyan thos dgra bcom zil gyis gnon nus par thal/ byang sems sa bdun pa'i rgyud kyi gnyis med kyi blo gros des nyan rang dgra bcom zil gyis gnon nus pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ ma grub na/ der thal/ de ni ring du song bar blo yang lhag par 'gyur zhes pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir ro/

/gzhan yang / byang sems sa dang po pa'i rgyud kyi don dam sems bskyed des nyan rang dgra bcom zil gyis gnon nus par thal/ de'i rgyud kyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab des nyan rang dgra bcom zil gyis gnon nus pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ de'i rgyud kyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab des nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi shes rab las lhag pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ de nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi de las thabs snying rje chen pos zin pa'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ rtags sla/ 'o na khyod rang la yang pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyi spros bral rtogs pa'i lta ba las sngags lugs kyi spros bral rtogs pa'i lta ba lhag par thal/ de las de thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir/ khyab pa dngos/ rtags der thal/ 'on kyang spros bral rtogs pa yi/ /thabs la gsang sngags khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gong du 'dod na/ pha rol phyin pa'i spros bral las/ /lhag pa'i lta ba yod na ni/ /lta de spros pa can du 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i gzhung don ma grub par thal lo/ /gzhan yang / byang sems mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod pa chos can/ khyod khyod rang gi rgyud kyi kun rdzob sems bskyed kyis nyan rang dgra bcom zil gyis gnon nus pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod kun rdzob sems bskyed kyi stobs kyis nyan rang dgra bcom zil gyis gnon nus pa'i gang zag yin pa gang zhig khyod khyod rang las rgyud gzhan pa'i gang zag gi rgyun kyi kun rdzob sems bskyed kyi stobs kyis nyan rang dgra bcom zil gyi gnon nus pa'i gang zag ma yin pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ gnyis pa ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod khyod rang las rgyud gzhan pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na sla/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/

khyod kyi rgyud kyi kun rdzob sems bskyed yod par thal lo/ /gzhan yang / byang sems sa dang po pa'i rgyud kyi kun rdzob sems bskyed kyis nyan rang dgra bcom zil gyi gnon nus la/ de'i rgyud kyi don dam sems bskyed kyis de ltar mi nus pa'i khyad par 'thad par thal/ dang po gang zhig phyi ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis dngos/ 'dod na/ de'i rgyud kyi kun rdzob sems bskyed las de'i rgyud kyi don dam sems bskyed nus pa chung bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ 'dod na/ de min par thal/ de'i rgyud kyi kun rdzob sems bskyed las de'i rgyud kyi don dam sems bskyed khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ de'i rgyud kyi kun rdzob sems bskyed khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ de'i rgyud kyi kun rdzob sems bskyed de gnyis snang dang bcas pa'i blo yin pa gang zhig de'i rgyud kyi don dam sems bskyed de gnyis snang nub pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ chos can gyis 'grub/ phyi ma yang chos can gyis 'grub bo/ /ma khyab la/ 'o na/ byang sems sa dang po pa'i rgyud kyi kun rdzob sems bskyed yin na/ nyan rang dgra bcom zil gyis gnon nus pa'i blo yin par thal/ de'i rgyud kyi kun rdzob sems bskyed des nyan rang dgra bcom zil gyis gnon nus pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam rjes thob khyad par lam la gnas pa'i byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i kun rdzob sems bskyed chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags chos can gyis 'grub/ 'dod na/ de'i rgyud kyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i blos nyan rang dgra bcom rnams zil gyis gnon nus par thal lo/ /'dod na/ byang sems sa dang po pa'i rgyud kyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i blos nyan rang dgra bcom zil gyi gnon nus par thal lo/

'dod na dngos 'gal/ gzhan yang byang sems sa dang po pa de/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems lta dang po la gnas kyang / /zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i byang sems yin par thal/ des nyan rang dgra bcom bsod nams kyi stobs kyis zil gyi gnon nus la/ blo gros kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon mi nus so zhes 'chad pa la/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems lta dang po la gnas kyang / /zhes sogs kyi gzhung de byung ba'i phyir ro/ /'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod de'i thad du 'jug 'grel du mdo drangs pa las/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpas dang por byang chub tu sems bskyed nas ring por ma lon pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi rgyal po'i rigs su skyes pas kyang byang chub kyi sems dang snying rje'i dbang gis nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas yun ring du tshangs par spyad pa rnams zil gyis gnon to zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i byang sems yin par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig 'jug 'grel du de gnyis sbyar nas bshad pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ 'jug 'grel du de gnyis sbyar nas bshad pa'i go don ni/ nyan rang dgra bcom bsod nams kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus pa'i mas mtha'i sa mtshams/ theg chen tshogs lam nas 'jog cing / des na gzhung rtsa ba'i dngos bstan gyi byang sems sa dang po pas nyan rang dgra bcom bsod nams kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus par ma zad/ mdo'i dngos bstan gyi byang sems las dang po des kyang nyan rang dgra bcom bsod nams gyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus zhes pa'i don yin/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod byang sems las dang po pa yin par thal lo/ /'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod byang sems tshogs lam yin par thal/ 'dod na sla/ yang de chos can/ khyod theg chen sems bskyed thob nas yun ring por ma lon pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod 'grel pa de'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/

'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod de min par thal/ khyod theg chen sems bskyed thob nas bskal chen grangs chen gcig tu tshogs bsags zin pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ khyod sa dang po thob pa'i gang zag gang zhig bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs gsog pa'i tshe theg chen tshogs sbyor man chad du bskal chen grangs med gcig tu tshogs gsogs dgos pa'i phyir/ rtags phyi ma der thal/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab brnyes byas/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab bsags/ /chos la mi rtogs ye shes ni/ /skyes phyir de ni dam par 'dod ni/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /yang / byang sems sa dang po pa chos can/ khyod nyan rang dgra bcom pa gnyis las tshangs spyod yun thung ba'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod 'grel pa de'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i rgyal sras yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod de min par thal/ khyod nyan rang dgra bcom pa gnyis las tshangs spyod yun ring ba'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ khyod de gnyis las tshogs gsog pa yun ring ba'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ nyan thos dgra bcom pas tshe gsum du tshogs bsags ste dgra bcom par 'bras bus thob/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pa des bskal pa brgyar tshogs bsags nas dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bus thob/ byang sems sa dang po pa des bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags te sa dang po thob pa yin pa'i phyir te/ tshe gsum bskal pa brgya dang ni/ /grangs med gsum gyis de mthar phyin/ /zhes pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs ma thag pa'i rgyal po'i sras des rang gi blon po'i tshogs rnams bsod nams kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus la blo gros kyi stobs kyis zil gyi gnon mi nus pa'i khyad par 'thad par thal/

de ltar yin pa dang byang sems sa dang po pas nyan rang dgra bcom bsod nams stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus la/ blo gros kyis zil gyis gnon mi nus pa gnyis po de don du sbyar nas bshad pa'i phyir te/ 'jug 'grel du mdo drangs pa las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di lta ste/ dper na rgyal po'i rigs su skyes pa'i rgyal po'i bu rgyal po'i mtshan dang ldan pa ni zhes sogs kyi gzhung don grub pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa bar 'dod na/ khyod kyis rang gi blon po'i tshogs rnams blo gros kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon mi nus par thal/ khyod rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs ma thag pa'i rgyal po'i sras yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la khyab pa yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ 'dod na/ rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i sras su 'khrungs ma thag pa'i rgyal po don grub chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags chos can gyis 'grub/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod kyis de ltar nus par thal/ khyod rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs ma thag pa'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs ma thag pa'i byang sems sa bcu pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags der thal/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ de yod pa'i phyir/ mdo sde rgyan las/byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ni/ /khyim pa 'khor los bsgyur rnams su/ /gyur nas skye ba thams cad du/ /sems can rnams kyi don byed do/ /zhes pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod kyis de ltar nus par thal/ chos can kho rang yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / byang sems sa dang po pas nyan thos dgra bcom pa blo gros kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus par thal/ byang sems sa dang po pas mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa gang zhig nyan thos dgra bcom pas de ltar ma rtogs pa'i phyir ro/

/dang po ma grub na/ der thal/ mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems sa dang po pa yod pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ ma grub na/ de yod par thal/ byang 'phags de de yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod der thal/ khyod byang sems sa dang po yin pa gang zhig mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings de khyed kyis mngon sum gyi rtogs bya yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ khyod byang 'phags thob ma thag pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags sla/ gnyis pa ma grub na/ mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings chos can/ khyod der thal/ khyod byang sems sa bdun pa ba'i mngon sum gyis rtogs bya yin pa'i phyir te/ byang sems sa bdun pa ba de khyod mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod der thal/ khyod sa bdun pa thob pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gong du ma khyab la/ mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems sa dang po de/ kho kho rang yin par thal/ kho yin pa yod pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings de khyod kyi mngon sum gyi rtogs bya yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod byang sems sa dang po pa'i mngon sum gyi rtogs bya yin par thal lo/ /'dod na/ de chos can/ byang sems sa dang po pas khyod mngon sum du rtogs par thal lo/ /'dod na dngos 'gal/ yang kho kho rang yin par thal la ma khyab byas pa la/ gsal pa der thal/ mtha' bzhi sprod bral gyi chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang 'phags de byang sems sa dang po ba yin pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ ma grub na/ der thal/ mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang 'phags kyi mas mtha'i sa mtshams byang sems sa dang po pa nas/

yas mtha'i sa mtshams sa bcu pa'i bar la 'jog dgos pa'i phyir te/ mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems sa dang po pa yang yod/ de 'dra'i sa gnyis pa ba yang yod/ de 'dra'i sa bcu pa ba'i bar rnams yod pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ de yod par thal/ byang 'phags de de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa der thal/ byang sems sa gnyis pa ba dang sa bdun pa ba gang rung du gyur pa'i byang 'phags de de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang gong du/ mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang 'phags de byang sems sa dang po pa yin pa'i phyir la ma khyab byas pa la/ de chos can/ byang sems sa dang po pa min par thal/ byang sems sa bdun pa ba yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de der thal/ mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mas mtha'i sa mtshams sa bdun pa nas 'jog rigs pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ nyan rang dgra bcom blo gros kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus pa'i mas mtha'i sa mtshams sa bdun nas 'jog rigs pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ ma grub na/ der thal/ rang 'grel las/ ring du song ba kho na nas bzung nas ni zhes nges bzung gi tshig dang bcas te gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rang lugs gnad kyi snying po ni/ nyan rang dgra bcom blo gros kyi stobs kyis zil gyi gnon nus pa'i mas mtha'i sa mtshams sa bdun pa nas 'jog cing / de'i go don yang sa bdun pa'i rnam grol lam skad cig ma dang po nas mtshan 'dzin slar mi skye ba'i chos can du byas te/ mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis nyan rang dgra bcom blo gros kyis stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus pa yin la/ sa drug pa man chad du mtshan 'dzin slar mi skye ba'i chos can du byas pa'i sgo nas/ mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa med pas sa drug pa ba man chad kyis nyan rang dgra bcom blo gros kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon mi nus par 'jog pa'i gnad kyang de ltar yin/

spyir sa bdun pa'i bar chad med lam skad cig ma dang po la gnas pa'i byang 'phags de/ mtshan 'dzin slar mi skye ba'i chos can du byed pa'i gnyen po bar chad med lam thob pa'i sgo nas/ nyan rang rnams blo gros kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus par 'jog pa yin no/ /gzhan yang / nyan thos dgra bcom pas mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs par thal/ mtha' bzhi spros bral gyis chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa yod pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ ma grub na/ der thal/ dgra bcom pa de/ de yin pa'i phyir ro/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod de min par thal/ khyod nyan thos dgra bcom pa gang zhig khyod yin na/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rang lugs ni/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi dbu ma'i lta ba'i yul gyi gtso bor gyur pa'i chos dbyings de rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis tsam dang bral ba'i chos dbyings yin yang / mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings ma yin te/ gal te yin na nyan thos dgra bcom pa chos can/ khyod mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod khyod rang gi rgyud kyi dbu ma'i lta ba'i yul du gyur pa'i chos dbyings de mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings su mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod der thal/ khyod khyod rang gi rgyud kyi dbu ma'i lta ba'i yul du gyur pa'i chos dbyings chos dbyings su mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa gang zhig khyod khyod rang gi rgyud kyi dbu ma'i lta ba'i yul du gyur pa'i chos dbyings de rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis tsam dang bral ba'i chos dbyings su mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ khyod khyod rang gang zhig

khyod chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis sla/ rtsa ba'i rtags gnyis pa ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud kyi dbu ma'i lta ba'i yul du gyur pa'i chos dbyings de rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis tsam dang bral ba'i chos dbyings yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i rgyud kyi dbu ma'i lta ba'i yul du gyur pa'i chos dbyings chos can/ khyod rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis tsam dang bral ba'i chos dbyings min par thal/ khyod mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dngos/ 'dir rang lugs kyi rdzas spyi'i skyong lugs dang bstun na/ mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings mngon sum rtogs pa'i so so skye bo yang yod par khas len dgos te/ gang zag de de yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang de kho kho rang min/ de bzhin du mtha' bzhi'i spros bral gyi chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i nyan thos tshogs lam pa yang yod de/ lam zhugs kyi gang zag de de yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang de kho kho rang min/ des mtshon nas/ rdzas spyi'i bsgrub lugs 'bab pa rnams la skyong lugs de bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i gnad ma shes pa'i tshe gang zag de gang zag gi rgyud kyi mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i lta ba rgyud ldan gyi gang zag ma yin/ 'o na su zhig de rgyud ldan yin snyam na/ byang sems sa bdun pa ba de/ de lta bu'i lta ba rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yin zhes khas len dgos pa yin no/ /gzhan yang / nyan thos dgra bcom pa chos can/ khyod dbu ma pa yin par thal/ khyod chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod theg chen gyi grub mtha' smra ba'i gang zag yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod theg chen gyi gang zag yin par thal lo zer na/

ma khyab/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod de min par thal/ khyod theg dman gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ma khyab tsam la/ de chos can/ khyod theg chen gyi gang zag yin par thal/ sde snod dang grub mthas phye ba'i theg chen gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ dbu ma pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags dngos/ gzhan yang / nyan thos dgra bcom pa chos can/ khyod phyi don bden med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod chos thams cad bden med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod phyi don bden med du mngon sum du mthong ba la sgrib par byed pa'i phyi don bden 'dzin gyi shes sgrib gzung rtog spangs pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab ste/ khyod rang la/ nyan thos mthong lam pa chos can/ khyod gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa la sgrib byed kyi gang zag gi bdag 'dzin spang pa'i gang zag du thal/ khyod gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa dngos/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod gang zag gi bdag 'dzin lhan skyes spangs pa'i gang zag tu thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod de min par thal/ khyod nyan thos slob pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / nyan rang gnyis kyi lam du spang bya spong tshul la khyad par med par thal/ de gnyis kyi lam du bdag med rtogs tshul la khyad par med pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ ma grub na/ der thal/ de gnyis char gyi gang zag gi bdag med/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med gsum char rtogs pa'i phyir te/ de gnyis char gyis chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /gong du 'dod na/ de gnyis kyi lam du spang bya spong tshul la khyad par yod par thal/ nyan thos lam du phyi don bden 'dzin gyi shes sgrib gzung rtog spong ba med pa gang zhig

rang rgyal lam du de spong ba yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / byang sems sa dang po pa de chos can/ khyod chos thams cad kyi chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod chos thams cad bden med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ chos nyid yin na/ khyod kyi mngon sum gyi rtogs bya yin dgos par thal lo zer na/ ma khyab/ 'dod na/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos nyid chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ byang sems sa dang po pa de khyod mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag du thal lo/ /'dod na/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos nyid de sangs rgyas nang phan tshun kho na'i mngon sum gyi spyod yul ma yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ de ltar byas pa la kho na re/ byang sems sa dang po pa chos can/ khyod dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod de bden med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod der thal/ khyod chos thams cad bden med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab ste/ 'o na byang sems sa dang po pa chos can/ khyod mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod de bden med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ khyod chos thams cad bden med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa dngos/ gzhan yang / byang sems sa drug pa ba chos can/ khyod mtha' bzhi spros bral gyis chos dbyings rtogs pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings la zhib tu spyod pa'i shes rab thob pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ ma grub na/ der thal/ lam phar phyin bcu'i nang nas lam shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la lhag par spyod pa'i nus pa thob pa'i rgyal sras yin pa'i phyir te/

chos can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ma khyab tsam la/ 'o na/ de chos can/ khyod mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos nyid don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig khyod de mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag ma yin pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod de rtogs pa'i gang zag tu thal lo/ /'dod na dngos 'gal/ 'dir rang lugs khas len tshul ni/ byang sems sa drug pa ba des mnyam gzhag du mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings la zhib tu dpyad pa'i nus pas/ rjes thob tu mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa zhig yod de/ sa bdun par mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa nges par yod la/ mtha' bzhi spros bral chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa la/ de don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa nges par sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir/ des na mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i byang sems sa drug pa ba yod ces khas len no/ /de ltar rang lugs la dogs pa dpyad nas/ rtsa ba'i gnyis pa gzhan lugs la dogs pa dpyad pa la/ kha cig na re/ nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yang med/ stong nyid rtogs pa yang med/ chos nyid rtogs pa yang med do zhes zer na/ nyan rang la stong nyid rtogs pa yod par thal/ nyan rang la chos thams cad rang bzhin med par rtogs pa yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ nyan rang la chos thams cad rang bzhin med par yongs su shes pa yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ rang 'grel las/ lung 'di las ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams la yang chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa yang yod do/ /zhes pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / nyan rang la chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pa yod par thal/ de med par 'dod pa la dpal ldan zla ba grags pas 'gal ba brjod pa'i thal 'gyur gsum 'phangs nas tshar bcad pa'i phyir/

ma grub na/ der thal/ rang 'grel las/ dngos po rang bzhin med par yongs su shes pa dang bral ba'i phyir zhes sogs kyi gzhung don grub pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ 'grel pa de la go don gcig gyis dang / gzhan yang / nyan thos dgra bcom pa chos can/ khyod chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod rang rgyud kyi phung po lnga bden med du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa gang zhig rang rgyud kyi phung po lnga bden med du rtogs pa gang zag yin na/ chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin dgos pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ khyod rang rgyud kyi phung po lnga bden med du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa gang zhig khyod gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /phyi ma der thal/ rten 'brel gyi rtags las chos gcig bden med du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin na/ rten 'brel gyi rtags las chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ dbu ma bzhi brgya pa las/ gcig gi stong nyid gang yin pa/ /de ni kun gyi stong nyid yin/ /gcig gi lta po gang yin pa/ /de ni kun gyi lta po yin/ /zhes pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la rang rgyud pa rnams ni/ chos gcig gis chos nyid kun tu 'gro ba'i tshul gyis rtogs na/ chos thams cad kyi chos nyid rtogs pas khyab ces zer mod/ de ltar khyab ma khyab kyi dogs pa 'jug don med pas/ gzhung de'i dgongs par ma song ngo / /gzhan yang / nyan thos dgra bcom pa chos can/ khyod chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa gang zhig khyod 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i gang zag yang yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod der thal/ khyod gzung bya phyi rol gyi don bden med du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/

ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ khyod gzugs phung bden med du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ khyod rang rgyud kyi gzugs phung bden med du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i gang zag gang zhig khyod gzugs phung dang bcas pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa ba'i rtags gnyis pa ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod der thal/ khyod sems bden med du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa gang zhig khyod sems byung bden med du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ khyod rang rgyud kyi rnam shes kyi phung po bden med du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ khyod khyod rang gang zhig khyod gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa ba'i rtags gnyis pa ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod der thal khyod phung po phyi ma bzhi bden med du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod der thal/ khyod rang rgyud kyi phung po phyi ma bzhi bden med du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod der thal/ khyod khyod rang gang zhig khyod gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhang yang / nyan thos 'phags pa de chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ nyan thos 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi zlas phye ba'i yang dag pa'i lta ba de/ dbu ma'i lta ba yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod der thal/ khyod de dang rtag chad gang rung gi mthar lhung ba'i lta ba gang rung yin pa gang zhig phyi ma ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ khyod lta ba yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma ma grub na/ khyod mthar 'dzin gyi lta ba yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod spang bya yin par thal/

'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod de min par thal/ khyod 'phags lam yin pa'i phyir/ 'di 'dri'i rigs pa ni shin tu bzang ba yin no/ /gzhan yang / chos thams cad bden med du ma rtogs pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa yod par thal/ chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa yod pa'i phyir/ rtags dngos/ 'dod na/ chos thams cad bden grub tu 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin rgyud ldan gyi nyan thos dgra bcom pa yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud la chos gang yang rung ba la dmigs nas nyon mongs pa chags sogs skye bar 'gyur bar thal/ khyod chos thams cad bden grub tu 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de la khyab pa yod de/ 'jug pa las/ khyod kyis rnal 'byor bdag med mthong ba yi/ /gzugs sogs de nyid rtogs par mi 'gyur zhing / /gzugs la dmigs nas 'jug phyir 'dod chags sogs/ /skye 'gyur de yis ngo bo rtogs med phyir/ /zhes pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / phyi don bden med du rtogs pa'i sems tsam pa chos can/ khyod chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod phyi don bden med du rtogs pa'i gang zag gang zhig chos gcig bden med du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin na/ chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pas khyab pa khas blangs pa'i phyir ro/ /dang po ma grub na/ de der thal/ phyi don bden med du rtogs pa'i sems tsam pa yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ phyi don bden med du khas len pa'i sems tsam pa yod pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ rtags sla/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod yod par thal lo/ /'dod na/ rten 'brel zab mo'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i dngos smra ba yod par thal lo/ /'dod na/ rigs pa drug bcu pa las/ sangs rgyas lam la brten nas ni/

/kun la mi rtag smra ba rnams/ /rtsod pas dngos rnams mchog bzung nas/ /gnas pa gang yin dngos med do/ /zhes pa'i gzhung don ma grub par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rang lugs gnad kyi snying po ni/ dngos smra ba rnam pa gsum gyis chos gang yang bden med du rtogs pa med de/ bden med rtogs pa la rten 'brel zab mo'i gnad shes dgos shing / rten 'brel zab mo'i gnad shes pa'i dngos smra ba ni ri bong rwa dang chos mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / 'di la lung dang rigs pa'i gnad mang du yod mod 'og nas rim bzhin 'chad do/ /gzhan yang / nyan rang la chos thams bden med du rtogs pa med gsung mkhan gyi sa skya par grags pa rnams gsan cig nyan rang la chos thams cad bden stong du rtogs pa yod par thal/ 'phags pa klu sgrub theg pa gsum gyi sbyor lam la bdag med rtogs tshul la khyad par mi bzhed pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ thub pa dgongs gsal las/ 'phags pa klu sgrub rgyas 'bring gsum gyi dgongs pas theg pa gsum gyi sbyor lam la thabs kyi khyad pa dang / nges 'byed bzhis rang rang gi dmigs pa gsal mi gsal gyi khyad par ma gtogs pa/ bdag med rtogs pa la khyad par mi bzhed de zhes pa'i gzhung 'di la lab lab byed rigs pa'i phyir ro/ /de la kha cig 'di snyam du lung de'i don theg pa gsum ka'i sbyor lam gang zag gi bdag med tsam rtogs pa la khyad par med ces pa'i don yin no snyam na de ni shin tu rmongs pa ste/ 'phags pa thogs med kyi rjes su 'brangs ba'i sems tsam pa rnams dang / mngon rtogs rgyan gyi dgongs pa 'brel ba'i rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma pa rnams kyang / theg pa gsum ka'i sbyor lam gyis gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa tsam zhig 'dod par mthun pas/ de dag las logs su bkar nas/ 'phags pa klu sgrub theg pa gsum ka'i sbyor lam rnams kyis chos thams cad bdag med par rtogs pa la khyad par mi bzhed do zhes rnam dpyod kyi rus ston nas slob dpon so so'i bzhed srol ma 'dres par bshad pa la smyon 'dings pa'i gtam du snang ba'i phyir ro/

/rang lugs lung de'i dgongs don gyi snying po ni/ spyir 'phags pa thogs med kyi rjes su 'brangs ba'i sems tsam pa rnams dang / theg pa gsum gyi lam rim 'chad tshul mngon rtogs rgyan gyi dgongs don dang 'dres pa'i dbu ma rang rgyud pa rnams kyi lugs la nyan thos kyis gang zag gi bdag med tsam rtogs/ theg chen gyi gang zag rnams kyis de'i steng du 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med kyang rtogs so zhes 'dod pa yin la/ dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dgongs don gyi snying po dpal ldan zla ba grags pas phyin ci ma log par bkral ba'i skabs 'dir/ theg pa gsum ka'i sbyor lam rnams kyis chos thams cad bdag med pa'am/ bden par med par rtogs pa mtshungs zhing / de nyid sher phyin gyi mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs nges don gyi mdo thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin par 'phags klu sgrub bzhed do/ /zhes pa'i don yin pas/ de las gzhan du 'bru skyog sna tshogs rgyab nas lung chud gson par ma byed cig gzhan yang / tshad ma rigs pa'i gter gyi rang 'grel las/ nyan thos dang theg pa chen po 'ga' zhig 'phags pa gsum la bdag med rtogs pa'i khyad par mi 'dod de bden pa bzhi'i chos nyid dam chos thams cad bdag med par ma rtogs na bden pa mthong ba mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang mchog dman gyi khyad par ni snying rje dang thabs kyi bye brag la ltos par 'dod do/ /zhes bshad pa de mi 'thad par thal/ chos thams cad bdag med par ma rtogs na theg pa gsum po gang rung gi mthong lam thob pa med par khas blangs zin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di 'dri'i rigs pa la shes ldan gzur gnas kyis ltas na smyon 'ding ba med do/ /gzhan yang / nyan rang la stong nyid rtogs pa yod par thal/ theg dman gyi gang zag dang theg chen gyi gang zag gnyis bsam pa rgya che chung la brten nas 'byed pa yin gyi/ lta ba bzad ngan la brten nas 'byed pa ma yin pa'i phyir te/

dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i slob dpon dpal ldan mar me mdzad kyi gsung las/ bsam pa bzang po dgos pa'i shes byed du/ theg pa gsum yang bsam pas phye ba yin gyis/ lta bas phye ba ma yin zhes lan gcig ma yin par gsungs pa 'di la 'grel cung zad cig yod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rang gi lugs ni nyan rang dgra bcom pa gnyis kyis 'jig lta lhan skyes spangs pa'i sgo nas khams gsum las chags pa dang bral ba'i tshe gser dang bong ba mnyam/ g.yas nas tsandan gyi lde gus byugs pa dang / g.yon nas sta res bcad pa la chags pa dang sdang ba med/ g.yas nas tshig snyan pa brgya stong brjod pa dang / g.yon nas tshig mi snyan pa brgya stong brjod pa la khyad par cung zad kyang med par mdo bstan bcos mang po las bshad cing / de lta bu'i gang zag rnams kyis stong nyid ma rtogs na/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i gang zag cung zad kyang mi srid pa'i skyon yod pa'i gnad 'di dgongs nas/ bdag gi yongs 'dzin dam pas 'phags pa yin na/ dbu ma pa yin pas khyab/ 'phags pa yin na/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pas khyab/ 'phags pa yin na/ rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pas khyab/ 'phags pa yin na/ bden 'dzin rgyud la mi ldan pa'i gang zag yin pas khyab/ 'phags pa yin na/ las nyon gyis skye ba mi len pa'i gang zag yin pas khyab/ ces legs par gsungs pa yin no/ /de la kho na re/ theg pa gsum la lta ba mtho dman gyi khyad par yod par thal/ theg dman 'phags pa dang / theg chen 'phags pa gnyis la lta ba mtho dman gyi khyad par yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ theg dman 'phags pa 'i rgyud kyi dbu ma'i lta ba las ches khyad par du 'phags pa yang yin/ theg chen 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi dbu ma'i lta ba yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ ma grub na/ der thal/ byang sems sa bdun pa ba'i rgyud kyi mtha' mar lta ba kun zlog gi dbu ma'i lta ba de de yin pa'i phyir/

ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod der thal/ khyod dang po gang zhig phyi ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ de der thal/ byang sems sa bdun pa ba des nyan rang dgra bcom blo gros kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus pa'i phyir te/ de ni ring du song bar blo yang lhag par 'gyur/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags gnyis pa ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ chos can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ma khyab tsam la/ theg dman 'phags pa dang theg chen 'phags pa gnyis la lta ba mtho dman gyi khyad par yod par thal/ theg dman 'phags pa dang / byang sems sa bdun pa gnyis la dbu ma'i lta ba mtho dman gyi khyad par yod pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab/ ma grub na/ der thal/ theg dman 'phags pas mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings mngon sum du ma rtogs/ byang sems sa bdun pa pas mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /rigs pa'i snying po yi ge lam du bkod pa 'di rnams shin tu mtha' chod par yod pas blo gsal mkhas pa rnams kyis gces par zungs shig rgyal ba'i sras kyi bsod nams stobs nyid las/ /theg dman zil gyis gnon zhing theg pa gsum/ /chos nyid rtogs tshul mthun par lung rigs kyis/ /zhib tu 'chad pa kho bo'i man ngag yin/ ༈ /de tshe de la rdzogs sangs byang chub rgyu/ /dang po sbyin pa nyid ni lhag par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i skabs su/ ngag sbyor dang / mtha' dpyad gnyis/ dang po ni/ byang sems sa dang po de chos can/ khyod sbyin pa lhag par spyod pa'i yod tan dang ldan pa yin te/ khyod rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byed pa'i rgyur lam phar phyin bcu'i nang nas lam sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la lhag par spyod pa'i rgyal sras yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ lam sbyin sogs phar phyir drug gi grangs nges/ so so'i mtshan nyid/ so so'i dbye ba/ so so'i nges tshig de dag la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbye ba 'byed tshul bshad pa dang lnga/

dang po ni/ spyir lam sbyin sogs drug po de'i grangs nges 'jog pa'i tshul yod de/ gzhi bslab pa gsum gyi dbang du byas nas kyang de ltar du grangs nges/ lam tshogs gnyis kyi dbang du nas kyang de ltar du grangs nges/ byed las mngon mtho dang nges legs gnyis bsgrub pa'i dbang du byas nas kyang de ltar du grangs nges/ 'bras bu sku gnyis bsgrub pa'i dbang du byas nas kyang de ltar du grangs nges pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po grub ste/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i dbang du byas nas sbyin pa/ tshul khrims/ bzod pa gsum po de bzhag lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa'i dbang du byas nas bsam gtan de bzhag lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa'i dbang du byas nas shes rab de bzhag de gsum ka'i grogs byed pa'i dbang du byas nas brtson 'grus de bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bslab gsum dbang du mdzad nas ni/ /rgyal bas pha rol phyin pa drug /yang dag bshad de dang po gsum/ /tha ma gnyis kyis rnam pa gnyis/ /gcig ni gsum char la yang gtogs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ gtso bor bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi dbang du byas nas/ dang po gsum po de bzhag gtso bor ye shes kyi tshogs kyi dbang du byas nas brtson 'grus de bzhag pa'i phyir/ rtags gsum pa grub ste/ gtso bor mngon mtho bsgrub pa'i dbang du byas nas dang po gsum po de bzhag gtso bor nges legs bsgrub pa'i dbang du byas nas phyi ma gnyis po de bzhag de gnyis char gyi grogs byed pa'i dbang du byas nas brtson 'grus de bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags bzhi pa grub ste/ /dang po gsum la brten nas gtso bor gzugs kyi sku thob par byed/ phyi ma gnyis la brten nas gtso bor chos kyi sku thob par byed/ brtson 'grus kyis de gnyis ka'i grogs byed pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags phyi ma gsum char gyis lung ni/

bstan bcos 'di nyid las/ sbyin sogs chos gsum 'di dag phal mo che/ /bde bar gshegs pas khyim pa rnams la bsngags/ /bsod nams zhes bya'i tshogs kyang de dag nyid/ /sangs rgyas gzugs kyi bdag nyid sku yi rgyu/ /zhes dngos su gsung la de'i shugs la/ bsam gtan shes rab 'di dag phal mo che/ /bde bar gshegs par rab byung rnams la bsngags/ /ye shes zhes bya'i tshogs kyang de dag nyid/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi bdag nyid sku yi rgyu/ /zhes pa gcig thob pa yin no/ /brtson 'grus kun gyi grogs su 'gyur ba'i lung ni bstan bcos 'di nyid las/ yon tan ma lus brtson 'grus rjes 'gro zhing / /bsod nams blo gros tshogs ni gnyis kyi rgyu/ /zhes dang / mdo sde rgyan las kyang / /dge ba'i chos kyi nang na brtson 'grus mchog /'di ltar de la brten nas de rjes thob/ /brtson 'grus kyis ni mdo la bde gnas mchog /dngos grub 'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten rtogs/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams yin no/ /gnyis pa so so'i mtshan nyid ni/ bsam pa khyad par can gyis zin pa'i byang chub sems pa'i rgyud kyi gtong ba phun sum tshogs pa de/ lam sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ bsam pa khyad par can gyis zin pa'i byang sems kyi spong ba phun sum tshogs pa de/ lam tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ bsam pa rnam par dag pas zin pa'i byang sems kyi sems rgyud mi 'khrug par byed pa phun sum tshogs pa de/ lam bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ bsam pa khyad par can gyis zin pa'i byang sems kyi brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa de/ lam brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ des zin pa'i byang sems kyi bsam gtan phun sum tshogs pa de/ lam bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ des zin pa'i byang sems kyi shes rab phun sum tshogs pa de/

lam shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ lam phar phyin phyi ma bzhi po de lam phar phyin drug tu phye tshe/ lam shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par 'du zhing / bcur 'byed pa'i tshe phyi ma bzhi'i mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ bsam pa khyad par can gyis zin pa'i byang sems kyi thabs mkhas phun sum tshogs pa de/ lam thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ bsam pa khyad par can gyis zin pa'i byang sems kyi smon lam phun sum tshogs pa de/ lam smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ des zin pa'i byang sems kyi ye shes kyi phun sum tshogs pa de/ lam ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ des na lam gyi phar phyin bcu po de gang rung yin na/ pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin pas khyab ste/ dper na lam shes phyin dang gzhung sher phyin gang rung yin na sher phyin ma yin pas khyab pa bzhin no/ /de ltar yang slob dpon phyogs glang gis brgyad stong don bsdus las/ shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis med/ /ye shes de ni de bzhin gshegs/ /bsgrub bya de don sbyor ba yis/ /gzhung lam dag la de sgras btags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i mtshan nyid ni rim bzhin/ srid zhi'i pha rol tu phyin pa mthar thug pa'i sbyin pa'i ye shes de/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid yin pa nas/ srid zhi'i pha rol tu son pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes kyi mkhyen pa de/ ye shes kyi phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid yin pa'i bar rigs 'gre'o/ /des na phar phyin bcu po gang rung yin na/ rnam mkhyen yin pas khyab ste/ rang 'grel las/ des na pha rol zhes bya ba ni/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i pha 'gram dang ngogs te nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa ma lus par spangs pa mnga' ba'i rang bzhin sangs rgyas nyid de/ pha rol tu phyin pa ni pha rol tu gson pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na nyan rang gnyis kyi rgyud la lam phar phyin drug yod dam med snyam na/

nyan rang gnyis kyi rgyud la sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa sogs ni yod mod/ de dag gi rgyud la lam pha rol tu phyin pa drug ni med de/ theg bsdus bshad sbyar las/ nyan thos bse ru rnams la ni/ /pha rol phyin drug ming yang med/ /bcom ldan nyag gcig pha rol phyin/ /drug gi spyi la bzhugs pa lags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa so so'i dbye ba ni/ sbyin pa la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ zang zing gi sbyin pa/ chos kyi sbyin pa/ mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa/ byams pa'i sbyin pa dang bzhi yod/ dang po ni/ zang zing gi longs spyod sbyin par gtong ba'i dge ba lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ bsam pa rnam dag gis kun nas slangs te dam pa'i chos phyin ci ma log par 'chad pa'i dge ba lta bu la byed/ gsum pa la dbye na/ long spyod chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sbyin pa/ lus nad kyi 'jigs pa las skyob par byed pa'i sbyin pa/ srog 'chi bdag gi 'jigs pa las skyob par byed pa'i sbyin pa/ srid pa 'khor ba'i mthar ltung ba'i 'jigs pa las skyob par byed pa'i sbyin pa/ zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthar ltung ba'i 'jigs pa las skyob par byed pa'i sbyin pa dang lnga yod/ bzhi pa ni/ sems can la dmigs nas byams snying rje bsgom par byed pa'i dge ba la 'jog gnyis pa dman mchog gi sgos dbye na/ rnam par dag pa'i sbyin pa dang / ma dag pa'i sbyin pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'khor gsum rnam dag gi sbyin pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ chang dang dug dang mtshon cha la sogs la sbyin par gtong ba lta bu la byed/ yang de la theg pa'i sgo nas dbye na/ lam ma yin pa'i sbyin pa dang / lam du gyur pa'i sbyin pa gnyis/ /dang po ni/ lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi sbyin pa'i dge ba lta bu/ gnyis pa la dbye na/ nyan thos kyi lam du gyur pa/ rang rgyal gyi lam du gyur pa/ theg chen gyi lam du gyur pa'i sbyin pa gsum yod/

tshul khrims de la/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ dge ba chos sdus kyi tshul khrims/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims dang gsum/ dang po ni/ tshul khrims kyi mi mthun phyogs spong bar byed pa'i sdom pa'i dge ba lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ lam phar phyin bcu nyams su len pa'i dge ba lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni/ bsdu dngos bzhi'i sgo nas sems can kyi don byed pa'i dge ba lta bu la byed/ yang de la mchog dman gyi sgo nas dbye na/ rnam par dag pa'i tshul khrims dang / rnam par ma dag pa'i tshul khrims gnyis yod/ yang de la theg pa'i sgo nas dbye na/ lam yin pa dang / ma yin pa gnyis yod pa sngar dang 'dra/ bzod pa la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ sdug bsngal dang len gyi bzod pa/ gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa/ chos la nges par rtog pa'i bzod pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ chos kyi phyir du dka' ba spyod nus pa'i bzod pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhan gyi gnod pa byas pa la rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i bzod pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni/ dam chos zab mo'i don la mi skrag pa'i bzod pa lta bu la byed/ yang dman mchog dang / theg pa'i sgo nas dbye ba gong dang 'dra/ brtson 'grus la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ bsam pa'i brtson 'grus/ sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus/ phyin mi zlog pa'i brtson 'grus dang gsum/ byed las kyi sgo nas/ gus sbyor gyi brtson 'grus/ rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus/ de gnyis ka dang ldan pa'i brtson 'grus dang gsum yod/ mi mthun phyogs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ ma zhen pa'i brtson 'grus/ yongs su mi ngal ba'i brtson 'grus/ lam yongs su 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus dang gsum yod/ mchog dman dang theg pa'i sgo nas dbye ba sngar dang 'dra/ bsam gtan de la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ mthong chos la bde bar gnas kyi bsam gtan/

yon tan mngon par 'grub pa'i bsam gtan/ sems can don byed kyi bsam gtan dang gsum/ dang po ni/ shin sbyangs kyi bde bas zin pa'i bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi snyom 'jug lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ spyan lnga dang mngon shes drug bsgrub pa'i bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i bsam gtan lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni/ gzhan don du sprul pa sna tshogs ston pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi lta bu la byed/ mchog dman dang theg pa'i sgos dbye ba sngar dang 'dra/ shes rab de la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ thos byung gi shes rab/ bsam byung gi shes rab/ sgom byung gi shes rab dang gsum yod/ de re re la yang shes rab zab pa/ rgya che ba/ rno ba gsal ba/ myur ba'i shes rab ste lnga lnga yod do/ /mchog dman dang theg pa'i sgo nas dbye ba sngar dang 'dra/ bdun pa thabs mkhas la dbye na zab pa'i thabs mkhas/ rgya che ba'i thabs mkhas/ myur ba'i thabs mkhas/ mthu che ba'i thabs mkhas dang bzhi yod/ dang po ni/ 'khor gsum du rnam par mi rtog pa'i theg chen gyi thabs mkhas lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ chen po bdun ldan gyi thabs mkhas lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni/ phyag 'tshal ba sogs yan lag bdun ldan gyi thabs mkhas lta bu la byed/ bzhi pa ni/ mngon shes dang ldan pa'i thabs mkhas lta bu la byed do/ /mchog dman dang theg pa'i sgo nas dbye ba sngar dang 'dra'o/ /brgyad pa smon lam la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ zab pa'i smon lam sogs bzhi/ mchog dman dang theg pa'i sgos dbye ba sngar dang 'dra'o/ /dgu pa stobs la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ dad pa'i stobs/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs/ dran pa'i stobs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs/ shes rab kyi stobs te lnga yod/ dbye sgo phyi ma gnyis sngar dang 'dra'o/ /bcu pa ye shes la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi ye shes gsum yod/ dbye ba gzhan gnyis gong dang 'dra'o/
