dbu ma la 'jug pa 'di nyid dngos smra ba'i bstan bcos rnams dang dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i bstan bcos rnams las ches khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ bstan bcos 'di nyid sangs rgyas gnyis pa dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i dbu ma'i bstan bcos rnams la btus shing / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi lung rigs man ngag rnams ji lta ba bzhin brjod pa'i sgo nas/ nges don gyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar byed nus pa'i bstan bcos yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di nyid las/ lugs 'di dge slong zla grags kyis/ /dbu ma'i bstan bcos las btus nas/ /lung ji bzhin dang man ngag ni/ /ji lta ba bzhin brjod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gzhan yang 'jug pa rtsa 'grel 'di/ dngos smra ba'i bstan bcos rnams dang dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i bstan bcos rnams las khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ zab mo stong pa nyid kyi chos de dbu ma'i bstan bcos rnams las ma gtogs par dngos smra ba'i bstan bcos rnams las/ phyin ci ma log par ma bstan pa de bzhin du/ bstan bcos 'dir 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi bzhed srol bzang po la dngos smra bas 'gal ba'i lan rnams dang / slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs kyi lugs srol bzang po la/ dbu ma rang rgyud pas 'gal ba'i lan rnams phyin ci ma log par brjod pa 'di ni bstan bcos gzhan na med do zhes mkhas pa rnams kyis shes par bya dgos pa'i phyir te/ 'di nyid las/ 'di las gzhan na chos 'di ni/ /ji ltar med pa de bzhin du/ /'dir 'byung lugs kyang gzhan na ni/ /med ces mkhas rnams nges par mdzad/ /zhes dang / 'di'i rang 'grel las/ 'di ltar dbu ma'i bstan bcos ma gtogs par bstan bcos gzhan las stong pa nyid ces bya ba'i chos 'di phyin ci ma log par ma brjod pa de bzhin du/ kho bo cag gis ring lugs gang zhig 'gal lan dang bcas par snyad pa'i lugs 'di nas 'byung ba de yang stong pa nyid kyi chos ltar bstan bcos gzhan na med do zhes mkhas pa rnams kyis nges par mdzad du gsol lo/

/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di las gzhan na zhes pa'i 'di zhes pa ni/ 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i dbu ma'i bstan bcos rnams la 'jog cing / 'dir 'byung lugs kyang zhes pa ni 'jug pa rtsa 'grel gnyis la ngos 'dzin pa yin te/ sngar drangs pa'i rang 'grel gyi tshig don la brtags pas shes pa'i phyir/ 'di dag kyang cung zad rgyas par bshad na/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa'i grub chen brgyad cu'i bstod pa las/ 'jam dpal sku yi sprul par 'khrungs/ /klu sgrub dgongs pa thugs su chud/ /zla ba grags pa zhes bya ba'i/ /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa ni/ rgya gar lho phyogs su sku 'khrungs te skye ba lnga brgyar mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung zhing / rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul par yang grags pa dang / spyir rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas zhing de'i nang nas kyang nang don rig pa mdo sngags gnyis la mkhas pa'i mchog tu gyur la/ khyad par du yang dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dgongs don zab mo dbu ma'i lugs srol bzang po phyogs kun tu gsal bar mdzad pa la/ 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral zhing / ri mor bris pa'i ba las 'o ma bzhos te skye bo rnams bden par mngon par zhen pa las zlog par mdzad nus pa/ stong pa nyid kyi don phyin ci ma log par rtogs pas rdo'i ka ba la phyag mi thogs par dbyug pa nges don gyi lta ba zab mo dang gsang sngags bla med kyi nyams bzhes zung du 'brel bas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po des/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad cing / khyad par dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi nges don bstan pa'i snying po phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par mdzad do/ /dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub dang / dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i dgongs pa gangs can 'dir che cher gsal bar mdzad pa ni/

rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po nyid yin te/ bdag nyid chen po des thub pa dgongs gsal dang / gzhung lugs legs bshad dang / mkhas pa 'jug sgo rtsa 'grel la sogs pa rnams su/ 'phags pa klu sgrub dang / dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i dgongs pa 'di ltar du yin no zhes rdo rje'i tshig gis yang yang gsungs pa rnams/ slob dpon de dag gi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par bkral ba'i lugs srol phyin ci ma log pa kho nar snang bas so/ don 'di la dgongs nas mkhas pa'i dbang po stag tshang lo tsā ba'i gsung las kyang / klu sgrub ring lugs dbu ma chen po ni/ /zla bas legs bkral nyi mas bsgyur ba'i srol/ /bu bzhi las 'ong rtog ges ma bslad pa/ /gangs can mtha' bral rtser gshegs 'ga' yis gzigs/ /zhes dang / de'i rang 'grel las/ pa tshab kyi sras kyi thu bo bzhi las brgyud de bshad srol ma chad tsam du 'ong pa rtog ge dang rang rgyud kyi 'dres kyis ma bslad pa'i dbu ma chen po ni/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams dang / shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / dpang blo gros bstan pa dang / byang brtson gyi skye ba yin nam snyam pa/ 'jam gsar shes rab 'od zer/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ de rjes nub la khad du gyur mtshams/ lo chen skyabs mchog mtshan can dang / mkhas pa gzhon nu blo gros la sogs pa gangs can gyi dbu ma ba mtha' bral gyi rtse mor gshegs pa nyung zad 'ga' yis gzigs shing bshad de/ zhes dang / sa skya pa gong ma rnams lugs 'di bzhed par ni/ rje btsun chen po'i mngon rtogs ljon shing sogs na'ang gsal ba ltar/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇḍi tas/ dbu tshad gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ /tha snyad du yang mi slu ba/ /'dod pa tshad ma'i lugs yin te/ /rang rgyud phal cher de dang mthun/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /zhes gsal bar bshad pa yang / thugs gzu bor gnas pa'i gtam du snang ba'i phyir ro/

/dpal ldan zla ba grags pa dang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs sa skya paṇḍi ta'i dgongs don ji lta ba'i mtha' bral dbu ma chen po'i srol dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa ni/ kho bo cag gi 'dren pa thams cad mkhyen pa chen po dpal mang du thos pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho nyid yin te/ de yang gsung dngos las/ spyir rgyan drug gzhung la nges pa rnyed/ /dgos 'phags pa klu sgrub gzhung la 'dris/ /spyir rdo rje theg la bag chags sad/ /dgos rje btsun gong ma'i gsungs la 'dris/ /zhes gsung pa ltar/ spyir mdo sngags kyi gsung rab mtha' dag 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas ches cher gsal bar mdzad cing / khyad par mtha' bral dbu ma chen po'i lta ba la dbang 'byor ba'i sgo nas grub pa mchog gi dngos grub brnyes te/ dpal 'phags pa klu grub dang / dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i dgongs don/ gzhan gyis ma rnyed pa'i legs bshad kyi snying po rtsal 'thon du 'grel bar mdzad cing / dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi bstod pa rtsa 'grel dang / ngo mtshar dpal gyi 'khri shing gi dbu ma'i rtogs brjod rtsa 'grel la sogs pa mdzad pa'i sgo nas lam bzang dbu ma'i srol ches cher dar bar mdzad/ 'dren pa dam pa de nyid kyi bka' drin las kho bo cag gis/ spyir mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyi don la mi 'phrogs pa'i nges pa rnyed cing / khyad par bstan pa'i snying po nges don dbu ma chen po'i gnad la don gnyer 'bad pa chen po'i sgo nas gsung gi bdud rtsi yang yang myangs shing thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas yun ring du 'bad pa la brten nas/ dam chos dbu ma'i tshig don phyin ci ma log par 'chad rtsod rtsom pa la bsnyengs pa dang bral ba'i yid ches rnyed pa yin no/ /de yang gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir dbu ma'i yig 'jog phal che ba ni bshad yam lta bur len pa dang / phya bsdus kyi rigs pa ltar snang gzhung don la bsres pa kho na ma gtogs/

'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs don dang mthun pa cher mi snang la kho bo cag gi spyi don 'dir ni/ dbu ma'i gzhung las bshad pa'i grub mtha'i gdod khyer dang / slob dpon so so'i bzhed srol dang mthun pa'i brda chad rnams snying por 'dril/ de dag la shes byed du dgos pa'i lung rnams lung don gyi sgo nas bshad/ lung don dang mthun pa'i rigs pa'i phreng ba mtha' yas pa bkod pa'i sgo nas dbu ma'i srol shin tu gsal bar bgyis pa yin pas mkhas pa rnams dges pa chen po bskyod du gsol/ swa ti/ thub dbang bstan pa'i snying po dbu ma'i lam/ /'phags mchog klu sgrub bzhed gzhung kunda'i tshal/ /dpal ldan zla ba'i legs bshad 'od brgya yis/ /rnam par phye ba'i lugs bzang rmad byung gang / /rje btsun gong mas tshig nyung don rgyas pa/ /legs gsungs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa yis/ /gsal bar mdzad pa'i lung rigs snying po'i don/ /mnyan yod mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis rgya cher spel/ /khyad par gsung rab mang thos rnam dpyod gang / /klu sgrub snying po dngos nyid gzhan la ci/ /snyam du bsam nas nges don dbang gi rgyal/ /mkhyen pa'i rgya mtshor gnas bcas mgon de yis/ /mdo sngags spyi dang khyad par lugs 'di nyid/ /dpyad gsum rnam par dag pa'i lung rigs kyis/ /thub chen bstan pa ches cher gsal ba ni/ /rta ljang can gyis nor 'dzin khyon ltar mdzad/ /yongs 'dzin gang de'i legs gsung bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rnam dpyod yangs pa'i snod du legs bzung nas/ /shes ldan don gnyer mkhas pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /tshim par sbyin no legs bshad bcud myongs shig /chos 'di bla ma'i drung du yang yang thob/ /bar du lung dang rigs pas bsam zhing dpyad/ /de nas blo gsal mkhas pa'i tshogs la bshad/ /bshad pa'i snying po bstan bcos 'di byas so/ /da dung 'phags mchog klu sgrub dgongs don gyi/ /lung rigs mang du yod 'jam dbyangs rjes/

/legs bshad yin yang ha cang ma grags na/ /drin mi 'gyur zhes gsung phyir btang snyoms bzhag /legs bshad 'di nyid thog mar blo'i yul du/ /len par byas nas slar yang don gnyer na/ /bshad par bya 'o blo gsal mkhas pa rnams/ /dga' dang spro bas thos sgom rgyun bsrings shig /sngon bsags bsod nams nam mkha'i khyon las lhag bsam rgyas pa'i nyin byed ni/ /tshe dang dbang phyug dkyil 'khor rab rgyas phun tshogs kun la dbang 'byor ba'i/ /'od snang bye ba khrag khrig gang nas skye dgu'i rmongs mun drung 'byin mkhan/ /'jig rten gsum la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i chos kyi rgyal po'i bkas bskul nas/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyis/ /legs par phye ba'i nges don lam bzang mchog /blo gsal mkhas pa rnams la spel bya'i phyir/ /legs bshad lung rigs mdzes rgyan 'di byas so/ /rnam dkar dge des chos kyi rgyal po yi/ /sku tshe bskal pa'i bar du rab brtan zhing / /chab srid gaṅga'i rgyun ltar dar zhing rgyas/ /ji ltar bzhed rgu dbyar mtsho ltar gyur cig /gzhan yang bstan dang bstan 'dzin sa chen khyab/ /'gro kun bde skyid yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /mngon mtho'i skas las nges legs rtser son te/ /don gnyis mthar phyin thams can mkhyen thob shog /dpal ldan ma hā kā la rnam gnyis dang / /rnam mang thos sras dmag zor mched lnga yis/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin bu ltar skyong ba dang / /legs bshad 'di nyid dar ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /rgyan drug mchog gzhung 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dbyangs/ /gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir 'gran pa'i zla bral pa/ /mnyan yod bya rgod gshongs zhes yongs grags pa'i/ /gnas 'dir dam chos 'phel ba'i bkra shis byon/ /de ltar dbu ma'i spyi don lung rigs mdzes pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i gsung las/ dbu ma'i spyi don gcig rtsom dgos so gsung ba'i bka' lung yod pa dang /

nye ba'i rkyen bsod nams chen po'i dpal gyis mngon par mtho zhing / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa la/ bod kyi chos rgyal mes dbon gsum las kyang ches khyad par du 'phags pa/ rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po dpal nam mkha' tshe dbang phun tshogs dbang gi rgyal po'i gsung las dbu ma'i spyi don rtsoms shig gsung ba'i bka' lung lhur blangs te/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i gtsug rgyan chen po dpal mang du thos pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i gsung las skyes pa/ shākya'i dge slong mdo sngags mang du thos pa'i dbus na bde bar gnas pa/ 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis/ chu pho byi ba'i lo'i dbo'i zla ba'i yar tshes gcig nas mgo brtsams te/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i dus bzang po la/ 'dzam gling yongs la snyan par grags pa dpal mnyan yod bya rgod gshongs zhes bya ba mkhas pa'i mdun sa chen po legs bshad kyi sgra dbyangs rgyun mi 'chad par sgrog pa'i gnas su legs par sbyar ba'o/ /'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig /maṅga laṃ/ gcig zhus te dag /'di nyid 'dri ba rnams kyi mgo 'jug gi tshigs bcad rnams 'dor ba dang / bar skabs nas chol mno ste yig char gsil bur gtogs pa dang / rang bzo'i lhad 'jug pa sogs byung na dpal mgon tsa tur mu khas chad pas chod cig /dge'o bkra shis// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 278 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen/ zab don dbu ma'i spyi don lung rigs mdzes rgyan/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
